verses.1:1: In the beginning God made heaven and earth.
verses.1:2: But the earth was unseen and unformed, and darkness was over the abyss, and the Spirit of God was moving above the water.
verses.1:3: And God said, "Let light come to be." And light came to be.
verses.1:4: And God saw the light, that it was good. And God divided between the light and the darkness.
verses.1:5: And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And evening came and morning came, one day.
verses.1:6: And God said, "Let a vault come to be in the middle of the water, and let it be dividing between water and water." And it was so.
verses.1:7: And God made the vault, and God divided between the water which was under the vault and the water that was above the vault.
verses.1:8: And God called the vault Heaven. And God saw that it was good. And evening came and morning came, a second day.
verses.1:9: And God said, "Let the water that is under heaven be gathered into one gathering, and let the dry land appear." And it was so. And the water that was under heaven was gathered into their gatherings, and the dry land appeared.
verses.1:10: And God called the dry land Earth, and the collections of the waters He called Seas. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:11: And God said, "Let the earth sprout vegetation of plants, sowing seed according to kind and according to likeness, and the fruit-bearing tree making fruit whose seed is in it according to kind, for likeness, on the earth." And it was so.
verses.1:12: And the earth brought out vegetation of plants, sowing seed according to kind and according to likeness, and the fruit-bearing tree making fruit whose seed is in it according to kind on the earth. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:13: And evening came and morning came, a third day.
verses.1:14: And God said, "Let luminaries come to be in the vault of heaven for illumination of the earth, to rule the day and the night and to divide between the day and the night; and let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and for years;
verses.1:15: and let them be for illumination in the vault of heaven, so as to shine on the earth." And it was so.
verses.1:16: And God made the two great luminaries, the great luminary for rule of the day and the lesser luminary for rule of the night, and the stars.
verses.1:17: And God placed them in the vault of heaven, so as to shine on the earth,
verses.1:18: and to rule the day and the night, and to divide between the light and the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:19: And evening came and morning came, a fourth day.
verses.1:20: And God said, "Let the waters bring out creeping things of living creatures, and birds flying above the earth across the vault of heaven." And it was so.
verses.1:21: And God made the great sea creatures and every living creature of the creeping animals, which the waters brought out according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to kind. And God saw that they were good.
verses.1:22: And God blessed them, saying, "Increase and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth."
verses.1:23: And evening came and morning came, a fifth day.
verses.1:24: And God said, "Let the earth bring out the living creature according to kind, four-footed animals and creeping things and wild animals of the earth according to kind." And it was so.
verses.1:25: And God made the wild animals of the earth according to kind and the livestock according to kind and all the creeping things of the earth according to their kind. And God saw that they were good.
verses.1:26: And God said, "Let Us make man according to Our image and according to likeness, and let them rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven and the livestock and all the earth and all the creeping things that creep on the earth."
verses.1:27: And God made man; according to the image of God He made him; male and female He made them.
verses.1:28: And God blessed them, saying, "Increase and multiply, and fill the earth and gain mastery over it, and rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven and all the livestock and all the earth and all the creeping things that creep on the earth."
verses.1:29: And God said, "See, I have given you every seed-bearing plant sowing seed which is upon all the earth, and every tree which has in itself fruit of seed for sowing; it will be food for you,
verses.1:30: and for all the wild animals of the earth and for all the birds of heaven and for every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, which has in itself a soul of life, every green plant for food." And it was so.
verses.1:31: And God saw all the things that He had made, and look, they were very good. And evening came and morning came, a sixth day.
verses.2:1: And heaven and earth were completed, and all their adornment.
verses.2:2: And God finished on the sixth day His works which He had made, and He rested on the seventh day from all His works which He had made.
verses.2:3: And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because in it He rested from all His works which God had begun to make.
verses.2:4: This is the book of the origin of heaven and earth, when it came to be, in the day that the Lord God made heaven and earth,
verses.2:5: and every green thing of the field before it came to be on the earth, and every plant of the field before it sprang up. For God had not sent rain on the earth, and there was no man to work the earth;
verses.2:6: but a spring was going up out of the earth and was watering the whole face of the earth.
verses.2:7: And God formed the man, dust from the earth, and breathed into his face a breath of life, and the man became a living creature.
verses.2:8: And the Lord God planted a garden in Eden toward the east, and placed there the man whom He had formed.
verses.2:9: And God further made to spring up out of the earth every tree beautiful to look at and good for food, and the tree of life in the middle of the garden, and the tree for knowing what can be known of good and evil.
verses.2:10: Now a river goes out from Eden to water the garden; from there it divides into four headwaters.
verses.2:11: The name of the one is Pishon; this is the one that encircles the whole land of Havilah, where the gold is.
verses.2:12: And the gold of that land is good; and the carbuncle and the green stone are there.
verses.2:13: And the name of the second river is Gihon; this is the one that encircles the whole land of Ethiopia.
verses.2:14: And the third river is the Tigris; this is the one that flows opposite the Assyrians. And the fourth river, this is the Euphrates.
verses.2:15: And the Lord God took the man whom He had formed and placed him in the garden, to work it and to guard it.
verses.2:16: And the Lord God commanded Adam, saying, "From every tree that is in the garden you shall eat for food;
verses.2:17: but from the tree for knowing good and evil, you shall not eat from it; and in whatever day you eat from it, you shall die by death."
verses.2:18: And the Lord God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone; let Us make for him a helper corresponding to him."
verses.2:19: And God further formed out of the earth all the wild animals of the field and all the birds of heaven, and He brought them to Adam to see what he would call them; and whatever Adam called it, a living creature, that was its name.
verses.2:20: And Adam gave names to all the livestock and to all the birds of heaven and to all the wild animals of the field; but for Adam there was not found a helper like him.
verses.2:21: And God cast a trance upon Adam, and he slept; and He took one of his ribs and filled up flesh in its place.
verses.2:22: And the Lord God built the rib that He had taken from Adam into a woman, and brought her to Adam.
verses.2:23: And Adam said, "This now is bone from my bones and flesh from my flesh; she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of her man."
verses.2:24: For this reason a man will leave his father and his mother and will be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.
verses.2:25: And the two were naked, both Adam and his wife, and they were not ashamed.
verses.3:1: Now the serpent was the most shrewd of all the wild animals on the earth which the Lord God had made. And the serpent said to the woman, "Why is it that God said, 'You shall not eat from any tree of the garden'?"
verses.3:2: And the woman said to the serpent, "From every tree of the garden we may eat;
verses.3:3: but from the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden, God said, 'You shall not eat from it, nor shall you touch it, so that you do not die.'"
verses.3:4: And the serpent said to the woman, "You will not die by death;
verses.3:5: for God knew that in whatever day you eat from it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like gods, knowing good and evil."
verses.3:6: And the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasing to the eyes to look at and beautiful to contemplate, and taking some of its fruit she ate; and she gave also to her husband with her, and they ate.
verses.3:7: And the eyes of the two were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made loincloths for themselves.
verses.3:8: And they heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden toward evening; and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God among the trees of the garden.
verses.3:9: And the Lord God called Adam and said to him, "Adam, where are you?"
verses.3:10: And he said to Him, "I heard the sound of You walking in the garden, and I was afraid, because I am naked, and I hid myself."
verses.3:11: And He said to him, "Who told you that you are naked, unless you have eaten from the tree that I commanded you, this one alone, not to eat from?"
verses.3:12: And Adam said, "The woman whom You gave to be with me, she gave me some from the tree, and I ate."
verses.3:13: And the Lord God said to the woman, "Why have you done this?" And the woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
verses.3:14: And the Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, cursed are you above all the livestock and above all the wild animals of the earth; on your chest and belly you will go, and earth you will eat all the days of your life.
verses.3:15: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; he will watch for your head, and you will watch for his heel."
verses.3:16: And to the woman He said, "I will greatly multiply your pains and your groaning; in pains you will bear children, and your turning will be toward your husband, and he will rule over you."
verses.3:17: And to Adam He said, "Because you listened to the voice of your wife and ate from the tree that I commanded you, this one alone, not to eat from, and you ate from it, cursed is the earth in your labors; in pains you will eat it all the days of your life;
verses.3:18: thorns and thistles it will raise up for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
verses.3:19: By the sweat of your face you will eat your bread until you return to the earth from which you were taken; for you are earth, and into earth you will depart."
verses.3:20: And Adam called the name of his wife Life, because she is the mother of all the living.
verses.3:21: And the Lord God made for Adam and his wife tunics of skin, and clothed them.
verses.3:22: And the Lord God said, "See, Adam has become like one of Us, in knowing good and evil; and now, so that he does not stretch out his hand and take from the tree of life and eat, and live forever—"
verses.3:23: And the Lord God sent him out of the garden of delight to work the earth from which he was taken.
verses.3:24: And He drove Adam out and settled him opposite the garden of delight, and He stationed the cherubim and the flaming sword that turns, to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.4:1: Now Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain. And she said, "I have acquired a man through God."
verses.4:2: And again she gave birth to his brother Abel. And Abel became a shepherd of sheep, while Cain was working the ground.
verses.4:3: And it happened after some days that Cain brought from the fruits of the ground a sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.4:4: And Abel himself also brought from the firstborn of his sheep and from their fat portions. And God looked upon Abel and upon his gifts,
verses.4:5: but to Cain and to his sacrifices He paid no attention. And it grieved Cain greatly, and his face fell.
verses.4:6: And the Lord God said to Cain, "Why have you become deeply grieved, and why has your face fallen?
verses.4:7: If you offer rightly, yet do not divide rightly, have you not sinned? Be still; toward you is his turning, and you will rule over him."
verses.4:8: And Cain said to Abel his brother, "Let us go out into the field." And it happened, while they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
verses.4:9: And God said to Cain, "Where is Abel your brother?" And he said, "I do not know; am I my brother's guardian?"
verses.4:10: And God said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries out to Me from the ground.
verses.4:11: And now cursed are you upon the earth, which opened its mouth wide to receive your brother's blood from your hand.
verses.4:12: For you will work the ground, and it will no longer give its strength to you; groaning and trembling you will be upon the earth."
verses.4:13: And Cain said to the Lord, "My guilt is too great for me to be forgiven.
verses.4:14: If You are driving me out today from the face of the earth, I will also be hidden from Your face, and I will be groaning and trembling upon the earth, and everyone who finds me will kill me."
verses.4:15: And the Lord God said to him, "Not so; everyone who kills Cain will incur sevenfold vengeance." And the Lord God set a sign for Cain, so that no one who found him would kill him.
verses.4:16: Then Cain went out from the face of God and settled in the land of Naid, opposite Eden.
verses.4:17: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch. And he was building a city, and he named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.4:18: And to Enoch was born Gaidad, and Gaidad fathered Maiel, and Maiel fathered Methuselah, and Methuselah fathered Lamech.
verses.4:19: And Lamech took for himself two wives; the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the second was Zillah.
verses.4:20: And Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of livestock-keepers who dwell in tents.
verses.4:21: And the name of his brother was Jubal; he was the one who introduced the harp and the lyre.
verses.4:22: And Zillah herself also gave birth to Tubal; and he was a hammerer, a smith of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal was Naamah.
verses.4:23: And Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, give ear to my words; for I have killed a man for a wound to me, and a young man for a bruise to me;
verses.4:24: because seven times vengeance has been taken for Cain, but for Lamech seventy times seven."
verses.4:25: And Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And she called his name Seth, saying, "For God has raised up for me another seed in place of Abel, whom Cain killed."
verses.4:26: And to Seth was born a son, and he called his name Enosh. He hoped to call upon the name of the Lord God.
verses.5:1: This is the book of the origin of human beings. On the day God made Adam, according to the image of God He made him;
verses.5:2: male and female He made them, and He blessed them. And He called their name Adam, on the day He made them.
verses.5:3: Now Adam lived two hundred thirty years, and he fathered one according to his form and according to his image; and he called his name Seth.
verses.5:4: And the days of Adam after he fathered Seth were seven hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:5: And all the days of Adam that he lived were nine hundred thirty years, and he died.
verses.5:6: Now Seth lived two hundred five years, and he fathered Enosh.
verses.5:7: And Seth lived seven hundred seven years after he fathered Enosh, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:8: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, and he died.
verses.5:9: And Enosh lived one hundred ninety years, and he fathered Kenan.
verses.5:10: And Enosh lived seven hundred fifteen years after he fathered Kenan, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:11: And all the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, and he died.
verses.5:12: And Kenan lived one hundred seventy years, and he fathered Mahalalel.
verses.5:13: And Kenan lived seven hundred forty years after he fathered Mahalalel, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:14: And all the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, and he died.
verses.5:15: And Mahalalel lived one hundred sixty-five years, and he fathered Jared.
verses.5:16: And Mahalalel lived seven hundred thirty years after he fathered Jared, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:17: And all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, and he died.
verses.5:18: And Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, and he fathered Enoch.
verses.5:19: And Jared lived eight hundred years after he fathered Enoch, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:20: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, and he died.
verses.5:21: And Enoch lived one hundred sixty-five years, and he fathered Methuselah.
verses.5:22: And Enoch pleased God for two hundred years after he fathered Methuselah, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:23: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
verses.5:24: And Enoch pleased God, and he was not found, because God transferred him.
verses.5:25: And Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, and he fathered Lamech.
verses.5:26: And Methuselah lived seven hundred eighty-two years after he fathered Lamech, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:27: And all the days of Methuselah that he lived were nine hundred sixty-nine years, and he died.
verses.5:28: And Lamech lived one hundred eighty-eight years, and he fathered a son.
verses.5:29: And he called his name Noah, saying, "This one will give us rest from our works and from the pains of our hands and from the ground which the Lord God cursed."
verses.5:30: And Lamech lived five hundred sixty-five years after he fathered Noah, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:31: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred fifty-three years, and he died.
verses.5:32: And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.6:1: And it came about, when people began to become numerous on the earth, that daughters were born to them.
verses.6:2: Then the angels of God saw the daughters of men, that they were beautiful, and they took for themselves wives from all whom they chose.
verses.6:3: And the Lord God said, "My Spirit will certainly not remain in these people forever, because they are flesh; rather, their days will be one hundred twenty years."
verses.6:4: Now the giants were on the earth in those days, and after that, whenever the sons of God went in to the daughters of men and they bore children for themselves. Those were the giants from ancient times, the men of renown.
verses.6:5: Now the Lord God saw that the evils of people had multiplied on the earth, and that every person intently directed his thoughts in his heart toward evil things every day.
verses.6:6: And God took it to heart that He had made man on the earth, and He thought it over.
verses.6:7: And God said, "I will wipe out man whom I have made from the face of the earth, from man to livestock and from creeping things to the birds of the sky, because I have become angry that I made them."
verses.6:8: But Noah found favor before the Lord God.
verses.6:9: Now these are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, being blameless in his generation; Noah was well-pleasing to God.
verses.6:10: And Noah fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.6:11: Now the earth was corrupted before God, and the earth was filled with injustice.
verses.6:12: And the Lord God saw the earth, and it was corrupted, because all flesh had corrupted its way on the earth.
verses.6:13: And God said to Noah, "The time of every person has come before Me, because the earth has been filled with injustice because of them; and look, I am about to destroy them and the earth.
verses.6:14: Therefore, make for yourself an ark out of squared timbers; you will make nests in the ark, and you will coat it inside and outside with asphalt.
verses.6:15: And this is how you will make the ark: three hundred cubits the length of the ark, and fifty cubits the width, and thirty cubits its height.
verses.6:16: You will make the ark tapering together, and you will finish it to a cubit above; and you will make the door of the ark on the side; you will make it with lower, second, and third stories.
verses.6:17: As for Me, look, I am bringing the flood of water upon the earth to destroy all flesh in which there is a spirit of life under the sky; and everything that is on the earth will die.
verses.6:18: And I will establish My covenant with you; and you will enter into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and the wives of your sons with you.
verses.6:19: And from all the livestock and from all the creeping things and from all the wild animals and from all flesh, two by two from all of them you will bring into the ark, so that you may nourish them with yourself; they will be male and female.
verses.6:20: From all the winged birds according to kind, and from all the livestock according to kind, and from all the creeping things that creep on the earth according to their kind, two by two from all of them will come in to you to be nourished with you, male and female.
verses.6:21: And as for you, take for yourself from all the foods that you will eat, and gather them to yourself, and it will be for you and for them to eat."
verses.6:22: And Noah did everything that the Lord God commanded him; so he did.
verses.7:1: And the Lord God said to Noah, "Enter into the ark, you and all your household, because I have seen you to be righteous before Me in this generation.
verses.7:2: From the clean livestock bring in to yourself seven by seven, male and female, and from the livestock that are not clean two by two, male and female;
verses.7:3: and from the clean birds of the sky seven by seven, male and female, and from all the birds that are not clean two by two, male and female, to nourish seed upon all the earth.
verses.7:4: For after seven more days, I am bringing rain upon the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe out every living creature that I have made from the face of the earth."
verses.7:5: And Noah did everything that the Lord God commanded him.
verses.7:6: Now Noah was six hundred years old, and the flood was upon the earth.
verses.7:7: And Noah, and his sons, and his wife, and the wives of his sons with him, entered into the ark because of the water of the flood.
verses.7:8: And from the birds, and from the clean livestock, and from the livestock that are not clean, and from the birds, and from all the creeping things that are on the earth,
verses.7:9: two by two they came in to Noah into the ark, male and female, just as God had commanded him.
verses.7:10: And it came about after the seven days that the water of the flood came upon the earth.
verses.7:11: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, on this day all the springs of the abyss burst open, and the floodgates of the sky were opened.
verses.7:12: And the rain came upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
verses.7:13: On this day Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons with him entered into the ark.
verses.7:14: And all the wild animals according to kind, and all the livestock according to kind, and every creeping thing that moves on the earth according to kind, and every bird according to kind
verses.7:15: entered in to Noah into the ark, two by two, male and female, from all flesh in which there is a spirit of life.
verses.7:16: And those that were going in entered, male and female from all flesh, just as God had commanded Noah; and the Lord God shut the ark from outside him.
verses.7:17: And the flood came upon the earth for forty days and forty nights upon the earth; and the water multiplied and lifted up the ark, and it was raised up from the earth.
verses.7:18: And the water prevailed and multiplied exceedingly upon the earth, and the ark was carried along over the water.
verses.7:19: And the water prevailed most exceedingly upon the earth, and it covered all the high mountains that were under the sky.
verses.7:20: Fifteen cubits upward the water rose, and it covered all the high mountains.
verses.7:21: And all flesh that moves on the earth died: of the birds, and of the livestock, and of the wild animals, and every creeping thing that moves on the earth, and every person;
verses.7:22: and everything that has the breath of life, and every one that was on the dry land, died.
verses.7:23: And He wiped out every living creature that was upon the face of all the earth, from man to livestock and creeping things and the birds of the sky; and they were wiped out from the earth. And Noah alone was left, and those who were with him in the ark.
verses.7:24: And the water was raised high upon the earth for one hundred fifty days.
verses.8:1: And God remembered Noah, and all the wild animals, and all the livestock, and all the birds, and all the creeping things that were with him in the ark; and God brought a wind upon the earth, and the water subsided.
verses.8:2: And the springs of the abyss and the floodgates of the sky were uncovered, and the rain from the sky was held back.
verses.8:3: And the water was receding, going away from the earth; the water was receding and diminishing after one hundred fifty days.
verses.8:4: And the ark came to rest in the seventh month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.8:5: Now the water continually diminished until the tenth month; and in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains appeared.
verses.8:6: And it came about after forty days that Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made,
verses.8:7: and he sent out the raven to see whether the water had subsided; and having gone out, it did not return until the water had dried up from the earth.
verses.8:8: And he sent out the dove after it to see whether the water had subsided from the earth.
verses.8:9: And the dove, not finding a resting place for its feet, returned to him into the ark, because water was on the whole face of all the earth; and stretching out his hand, he took it and brought it in to himself into the ark.
verses.8:10: And having waited yet another seven days, he again sent out the dove from the ark.
verses.8:11: And the dove returned to him toward evening, and it had an olive leaf, a twig, in its mouth; and Noah knew that the water had subsided from the earth.
verses.8:12: And having waited yet another seven days, he again sent out the dove, and it did not return to him anymore.
verses.8:13: And it came about in the six hundred and first year of Noah's life, in the first month, on the first day of the month, that the water vanished from the earth; and Noah uncovered the roof of the ark and saw that the water had vanished from the face of the earth.
verses.8:14: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dried up.
verses.8:15: And the Lord God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.8:16: "Come out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and the wives of your sons with you;
verses.8:17: and all the wild animals that are with you, and all flesh from birds to livestock, and every creeping thing that moves on the earth, bring out with you; and increase and multiply on the earth."
verses.8:18: And Noah went out, and his wife, and his sons, and the wives of his sons with him;
verses.8:19: and all the wild animals, and all the livestock, and every bird, and every creeping thing that moves on the earth, according to their kind, went out from the ark.
verses.8:20: And Noah built an altar to God, and took from all the clean livestock and from all the clean birds, and offered up a whole burnt offering on the altar.
verses.8:21: And the Lord God smelled a scent of sweet fragrance, and the Lord God, having considered, said, "I will not again curse the earth because of the deeds of people, because the mindset of man is intently set upon evil things from youth; therefore I will not again strike down all living flesh as I have done.
verses.8:22: All the days of the earth, seed and harvest, cold and heat, summer and spring, day and night, will not cease."
verses.9:1: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, "Increase and multiply, and fill the earth and gain mastery over it.
verses.9:2: And the dread of you and the fear will be upon all the wild animals of the earth, and upon all the birds of the sky, and upon all that moves upon the earth, and all the fish of the sea; I have given them under your hands.
verses.9:3: And every creeping thing that lives will be for you as food; like green herbs I have given everything to you.
verses.9:4: However, flesh with blood of life you must not eat;
verses.9:5: for indeed, your own blood of your lives I will require; from the hand of all the wild animals I will require it, and from the hand of a brother man I will require the life of the man.
verses.9:6: The one who sheds a man's blood, in return for his blood it will be shed, because in the image of God I made man.
verses.9:7: As for you, increase and multiply, and fill the earth and multiply upon the earth."
verses.9:8: And God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.9:9: "Look, I am establishing My covenant with you and with your seed after you,
verses.9:10: and with every living creature that is with you, from birds and from livestock, and with all the wild animals of the earth that are with you, from all that came out of the ark.
verses.9:11: And I will establish My covenant with you, and no flesh will die again from the water of the flood, and there will no longer be a flood of water to destroy all the earth."
verses.9:12: And the Lord God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant which I am giving between Me and you, and between every living creature that is with you, for everlasting generations:
verses.9:13: I place My bow in the cloud, and it will be for a sign of a covenant between Me and the earth.
verses.9:14: And it will happen when I gather clouds over the earth, My bow will be seen in the cloud,
verses.9:15: and I will remember My covenant, which is between Me and you and between every living creature in all flesh; and the water will no longer become a flood so as to wipe out all flesh.
verses.9:16: And My bow will be in the cloud, and I will look to remember an everlasting covenant between Me and every living creature in all flesh that is upon the earth."
verses.9:17: And God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is upon the earth."
verses.9:18: Now the sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth; Ham was the father of Canaan.
verses.9:19: These three are the sons of Noah; from these they were scattered over all the earth.
verses.9:20: And Noah began as a man who tilled the earth, and he planted a vineyard.
verses.9:21: And he drank from the wine and became drunk, and he was uncovered in his house.
verses.9:22: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and going out he reported it to his two brothers outside.
verses.9:23: And Shem and Japheth took the garment and placed it upon both of their backs, and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father; and their face was turned backward, and they did not see the nakedness of their father.
verses.9:24: And Noah sobered up from the wine, and came to know all that his younger son had done to him.
verses.9:25: And he said, "Cursed be Canaan; a household servant he will be to his brothers."
verses.9:26: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord God of Shem, and Canaan will be his servant.
verses.9:27: May God make room for Japheth, and let him dwell in the houses of Shem; and let Canaan become their servant."
verses.9:28: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.9:29: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years, and he died.
verses.10:1: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.
verses.10:2: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Elishah, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.10:3: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.10:4: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rhodians.
verses.10:5: From these the islands of the nations were separated in their land, each according to language, in their tribes and in their nations.
verses.10:6: And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim, Put and Canaan.
verses.10:7: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.10:8: And Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a giant upon the earth.
verses.10:9: He was a giant hunter before the Lord God; therefore they will say, "Like Nimrod, a giant hunter before the Lord."
verses.10:10: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.10:11: Out of that land Asshur went forth, and he built Nineveh, and the city of Rehoboth, and Calah,
verses.10:12: and Dasem, between Nineveh and Calah; this is the great city.
verses.10:13: And Mizraim fathered the Ludim, and the Naphtuhim, and the Anamim, and the Lehabim,
verses.10:14: and the Pathrusim, and the Casluhim, from whom the Philistines came out, and the Caphtorim.
verses.10:15: And Canaan fathered Sidon the firstborn, and the Hittite,
verses.10:16: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.10:17: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.10:18: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. And after this the tribes of the Canaanites were scattered.
verses.10:19: And the borders of the Canaanites were from Sidon until coming to Gerar and Gaza, until coming as far as Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, as far as Dasa.
verses.10:20: These are the sons of Ham in their tribes, according to their languages, in their lands, and in their nations.
verses.10:21: And to Shem also children were born, the father of all the sons of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder.
verses.10:22: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.10:23: And the sons of Aram: Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
verses.10:24: And Arphaxad fathered Cainan, and Cainan fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.
verses.10:25: And to Eber two sons were born; the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother was Joktan.
verses.10:26: And Joktan fathered Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.10:27: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.10:29: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
verses.10:30: And their dwelling place was from Mesha until coming to Sephar, a mountain of the east.
verses.10:31: These are the sons of Shem in their tribes, according to their languages, in their lands, and in their nations.
verses.10:32: These are the tribes of the sons of Noah according to their generations, according to their nations; from these the islands of the nations were scattered upon the earth after the flood.
verses.11:1: And all the earth was of one lip, and there was one speech for all.
verses.11:2: And it happened as they moved from the east that they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
verses.11:3: And a man said to his neighbor, "Come, let us make bricks and bake them with fire." And brick became stone for them, and asphalt was mortar for them.
verses.11:4: And they said, "Come, let us build for ourselves a city and a tower whose top will be up to heaven, and we will make a name for ourselves before being scattered over the face of all the earth."
verses.11:5: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men built.
verses.11:6: And the Lord said, "Look, there is one people and one lip of all; and this they have begun to do, and now nothing will fail them of all that they set themselves to do.
verses.11:7: Come, let Us go down and confuse their tongue there, so that each one may not understand the speech of his neighbor."
verses.11:8: And the Lord scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city and the tower.
verses.11:9: Because of this its name was called Confusion, because there the Lord confused the lips of all the earth, and from there the Lord God scattered them over the face of all the earth.
verses.11:10: And these are the generations of Shem. Shem was one hundred years old when he fathered Arphaxad, in the second year after the flood.
verses.11:11: And Shem lived five hundred years after he fathered Arphaxad, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died.
verses.11:12: And Arphaxad lived one hundred thirty-five years, and he fathered Cainan.
verses.11:13: And Arphaxad lived four hundred thirty years after he fathered Cainan, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died. And Cainan lived one hundred thirty years, and he fathered Shelah. And Cainan lived three hundred thirty years after he fathered Shelah, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died.
verses.11:14: And Shelah lived one hundred thirty years, and he fathered Eber.
verses.11:15: And Shelah lived three hundred thirty years after he fathered Eber, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died.
verses.11:16: And Eber lived one hundred thirty-four years, and he fathered Peleg.
verses.11:17: And Eber lived three hundred seventy years after he fathered Peleg, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died.
verses.11:18: And Peleg lived one hundred thirty years, and he fathered Reu.
verses.11:19: And Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he fathered Reu, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died.
verses.11:20: And Reu lived one hundred thirty-two years, and he fathered Serug.
verses.11:21: And Reu lived two hundred seven years after he fathered Serug, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died.
verses.11:22: And Serug lived one hundred thirty years, and he fathered Nahor.
verses.11:23: And Serug lived two hundred years after he fathered Nahor, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died.
verses.11:24: And Nahor lived seventy-nine years, and he fathered Terah.
verses.11:25: And Nahor lived one hundred twenty-nine years after he fathered Terah, and he fathered sons and daughters, and he died.
verses.11:26: And Terah lived seventy years, and he fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.11:27: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran, and Haran fathered Lot.
verses.11:28: And Haran died in the presence of Terah his father in the land in which he was born, in the country of the Chaldeans.
verses.11:29: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves; the name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, daughter of Haran, both the father of Milcah and the father of Iscah.
verses.11:30: And Sarai was barren and did not bear children.
verses.11:31: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran, the son of his son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, the wife of his son, and he led them out from the country of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan; and he came as far as Haran and settled there.
verses.11:32: And the days of Terah in Haran were two hundred five years, and Terah died in Haran.
verses.12:1: And the Lord said to Abram, "Go out from your land, and from your relatives, and from the house of your father, to the land that I will show you.
verses.12:2: And I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you, and I will magnify your name, and you will be blessed.
verses.12:3: And I will bless those who bless you, and those who curse you I will curse; and in you all the tribes of the earth will be blessed."
verses.12:4: And Abram went just as the Lord had spoken to him, and Lot went with him. Now Abram was seventy-five years old when he went out from Haran.
verses.12:5: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot the son of his brother, and all their possessions that they had acquired, and every soul that they had acquired from Haran, and they went out to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to the land of Canaan.
verses.12:6: And Abram traveled through the length of it as far as the place of Shechem, to the tall oak. Now the Canaanites were then inhabiting the land.
verses.12:7: And the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "To your seed I will give this land." And there Abram built an altar to the Lord who had appeared to him.
verses.12:8: And he moved away from there to the mountain east of Bethel, and he pitched his tent there in Bethel toward the sea, with Ai toward the east; and he built an altar there to the Lord and called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.12:9: And Abram set out, and having traveled on, he encamped in the wilderness.
verses.12:10: And a famine came upon the land; and Abram went down to Egypt to sojourn there, because the famine grew severe upon the land.
verses.12:11: Now it happened when Abram drew near to enter Egypt, Abram said to Sarai his wife, "I know that you are a woman of fair appearance.
verses.12:12: Therefore it will happen, as soon as the Egyptians see you, they will say, 'This woman is his wife,' and they will kill me, but they will keep you alive.
verses.12:13: Say therefore, 'I am his sister,' so that it may go well with me because of you, and my soul will live on account of you."
verses.12:14: Now it happened when Abram entered Egypt that the Egyptians saw his wife, that she was exceedingly beautiful,
verses.12:15: and the officials of Pharaoh saw her and praised her to Pharaoh, and they brought her in to Pharaoh.
verses.12:16: And they treated Abram well because of her, and he came to have sheep and calves and donkeys, male servants and female servants, mules and camels.
verses.12:17: And God afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great and grievous afflictions on account of Sarai, the wife of Abram.
verses.12:18: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, "What is this you have done to me, that you did not tell me that she is your wife?
verses.12:19: Why did you say, 'She is my sister'? And I took her for myself as a wife. And now, look, your wife is before you; take her and hurry away."
verses.12:20: And Pharaoh gave orders to men concerning Abram to escort him on his way, and his wife, and all that belonged to him, and Lot with him.
verses.13:1: And Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that was his, and Lot with him, into the wilderness.
verses.13:2: Now Abram was exceedingly rich in livestock, and in silver, and in gold.
verses.13:3: And he went from where he had come into the wilderness as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been previously, between Bethel and Ai,
verses.13:4: to the place of the altar where he had made the tent there; and there Abram called on the name of the Lord.
verses.13:5: And Lot, who was traveling with Abram, had sheep and oxen and livestock.
verses.13:6: And the land did not have room for them to live together, because their possessions were many, and they were not able to live together.
verses.13:7: And strife arose between the herdsmen of Abram's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock. Now the Canaanites and the Perizzites were then inhabiting the land.
verses.13:8: And Abram said to Lot, "Let there be no strife between me and you, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen, because we are men who are brothers.
verses.13:9: And look, all the land is before you; separate yourself from me. If you go to the left, I will go to the right; and if you go to the right, I will go to the left."
verses.13:10: And Lot lifted up his eyes and saw all the surrounding region of the Jordan, that all of it was watered (before God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah), like the garden of God and like the land of Egypt, until one comes to Zoar.
verses.13:11: And Lot chose for himself all the surrounding region of the Jordan, and Lot set out from the east; and they separated, each man from his brother.
verses.13:12: Now Abram settled in the land of Canaan, while Lot settled in a city of the surrounding regions and pitched his tent in Sodom.
verses.13:13: Now the men in Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinful before God.
verses.13:14: And God said to Abram after Lot had separated from him, "Look up with your eyes and see from the place where you now are, toward the north and the south and the east and the sea,
verses.13:15: because all the land that you see, to you I will give it and to your seed forever.
verses.13:16: And I will make your seed like the sand of the earth; if anyone is able to count out the sand of the earth, then your seed also will be counted.
verses.13:17: Get up, travel through the land both to its length and to its width, because to you I will give it and to your seed forever."
verses.13:18: And having moved his tent, Abram came and settled beside the oak of Mamre, which was in Hebron; and he built an altar there to the Lord.
verses.14:1: Now it came about in the reign of Amraphel king of Shinar, that Arioch king of Ellasar, and Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Thalga king of nations
verses.14:2: made war with Balla king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, and Sennaar king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and with the king of Balak; this is Zoar.
verses.14:3: All these united in agreement at the Salt Ravine; this is the Sea of Salt.
verses.14:4: For twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.14:5: And in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came, and they cut down the giants who were in Ashtaroth-karnaim, and strong nations with them, and the Somaites who were in the city of Shaveh,
verses.14:6: and the Horites who were in the mountains of Seir, as far as the terebinth of Paran, which is in the wilderness.
verses.14:7: And turning back, they came to the Spring of Judgment (this is Kadesh), and they cut down all the rulers of Amalek and the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
verses.14:8: Then the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah and the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim and the king of Balak (this is Zoar) went out, and they lined up against them for war in the Salt Valley,
verses.14:9: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Thalgal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar, these four kings against the five.
verses.14:10: Now the Salt Valley was pits of asphalt. And the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah fled, and they fell in there; and those who were left behind fled to the hill country.
verses.14:11: And he took all the cavalry of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their provisions, and they departed.
verses.14:12: They also took Lot, the son of Abram's brother, and his possessions, and went away; for he was living in Sodom.
verses.14:13: Then one of those who had escaped came and reported to Abram the migrant; now he was living by the oak of Mamre the Amorite, the brother of Eshcol and the brother of Aunan, who were sworn allies of Abram.
verses.14:14: And when Abram heard that Lot his brother had been taken captive, he numbered his own houseborn men, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued after them as far as Dan.
verses.14:15: And he fell upon them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them as far as Chobal, which is on the left of Damascus.
verses.14:16: And he brought back all the cavalry of Sodom; and he brought back Lot his brother, and all his belongings, and the women, and the people.
verses.14:17: Then the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after he returned from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and of the kings who were with him, to the Valley of Shaveh; this was the Plain of the King.
verses.14:18: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought out loaves of bread and wine; now he was priest of the Most High God.
verses.14:19: And he blessed Abram and said, "Blessed be Abram by the Most High God, who created heaven and earth;
verses.14:20: and blessed be the Most High God, who delivered your enemies into your hands." And he gave him a tenth of everything.
verses.14:21: Then the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the men, and take the cavalry for yourself."
verses.14:22: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I will stretch out my hand to the Most High God, who created heaven and earth,
verses.14:23: that I will not take from a thread to a sandal strap of anything that is yours, so that you may not say, 'I made Abram rich,'
verses.14:24: except what the young men have eaten, and the share of the men who went with me, Eshcol, Aunan, Mamre; these will take a share."
verses.15:1: Now after these words, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, "Do not fear, Abram; I shield you; your reward will be exceedingly great."
verses.15:2: And Abram said, "Master Lord, what will You give me? For I am departing childless, and the son of Masek my houseborn woman, this is Damascus Eliezer."
verses.15:3: And Abram said, "Since You have not given me seed, my houseborn servant will be my heir."
verses.15:4: And immediately the voice of the Lord came to him, saying, "This one will not be your heir; instead, the one who will come out from you, he will be your heir."
verses.15:5: And He brought him outside and said to him, "Look up now toward heaven and count the stars, if you are able to number them." And He said, "So will your seed be."
verses.15:6: And Abram believed God, and it was reckoned to him as righteousness.
verses.15:7: And He said to him, "I am God who brought you out from the country of the Chaldeans, so as to give you this land to inherit."
verses.15:8: And he said, "Master Lord, by what will I know that I will inherit it?"
verses.15:9: And He said to him, "Take for Me a three-year-old heifer, and a three-year-old female goat, and a three-year-old ram, and a turtledove, and a pigeon."
verses.15:10: So he took for Him all these, and divided them down the middle, and placed them opposite one another; but the birds he did not divide.
verses.15:11: And birds came down upon the carcasses, their divided pieces; and Abram sat down with them.
verses.15:12: Now around the setting of the sun, a trance fell upon Abram, and look, a great dark dread falls upon him.
verses.15:13: And it was said to Abram, "You will surely know that your seed will be a sojourner in a land not its own, and they will mistreat it, and enslave them, and humble them for four hundred years.
verses.15:14: But the nation whom they may serve I will judge; and after these things they will come out here with many possessions.
verses.15:15: As for you, you will depart to your fathers in peace, nourished in a good old age.
verses.15:16: And in the fourth generation they will return here; for the sins of the Amorites have not yet been filled up until now."
verses.15:17: And when the sun was approaching its setting, a flame came to be; and look, a smoking oven and torches of fire, which passed through between these divided pieces.
verses.15:18: There God made a covenant with Abram, saying, "To your seed I will give this land, from the river of Egypt as far as the great river Euphrates:
verses.15:19: the Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kelmonites,
verses.15:20: and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaim,
verses.15:21: and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites."
verses.16:1: Now Sarai, the wife of Abram, was not bearing children to him; and she had an Egyptian maidservant whose name was Hagar.
verses.16:2: And Sarai said to Abram, "Look, the Lord has shut me up from bearing; go in, therefore, to my maidservant, so that you may have children from her." And Abram listened to her voice.
verses.16:3: And Sarai, the wife of Abram, took Hagar the Egyptian, her own maidservant, after ten years of Abram's dwelling in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband as a wife for him.
verses.16:4: And he went in to Hagar, and she conceived; and she saw that she was pregnant, and the mistress was dishonored before her.
verses.16:5: And Sarai said to Abram, "I am wronged because of you. I gave my maidservant into your embrace, and when she saw that she was pregnant, I was dishonored before her. May God judge between me and you."
verses.16:6: And Abram said to Sarai, "Look, your maidservant is before you; treat her as it may be pleasing to you." And Sarai mistreated her, and she fled from her presence.
verses.16:7: And an angel of the Lord God found her by the spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the road to Shur.
verses.16:8: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "Hagar, maidservant of Sarai, where are you coming from, and where are you going?" And she said, "From the presence of Sarai my mistress I am fleeing."
verses.16:9: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "Return to your mistress and humble yourself under her hands."
verses.16:10: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "I will surely multiply your seed, and it will not be counted because of the multitude."
verses.16:11: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "Look, you are pregnant, and you will bear a son, and you will call his name Ishmael, because the Lord has listened to your humiliation.
verses.16:12: He will be a wild man; his hands will be against all, and the hands of all against him, and facing all his brothers he will dwell."
verses.16:13: And Hagar called the name of the Lord who was speaking to her, "You are the God who looked upon me"; for she said, "For indeed I saw in person the One who appeared to me."
verses.16:14: Because of this she called the well, "Well of the One Whom I Saw in Person"; look, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.16:15: And Hagar bore a son to Abram; and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore to him, Ishmael.
verses.16:16: Now Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.17:1: Now Abram was ninety-nine years old, and the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "I am your God; be well-pleasing before Me, and become blameless,
verses.17:2: and I will make My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly."
verses.17:3: And Abram fell on his face,
verses.17:4: and God spoke to him, saying, "And as for Me, look, My covenant is with you, and you will be the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.17:5: And your name will no longer be called Abram, but Abraham will be your name, because I have made you the father of many nations.
verses.17:6: And I will increase you exceedingly, and I will make you into nations, and kings will come out from you.
verses.17:7: And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your seed after you for their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be your God and the God of your seed after you.
verses.17:8: And I will give to you and to your seed after you the land in which you live as a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession, and I will be God to them."
verses.17:9: And God said to Abraham, "Now as for you, you shall keep My covenant, you and your seed after you for their generations.
verses.17:10: And this is the covenant which you shall keep between Me and you, and your seed after you for their generations: every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.17:11: And you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin, and it will be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
verses.17:12: And every male among you, a child eight days old, shall be circumcised for your generations: the one born in your house and the one bought with silver from any son of a foreigner, who is not of your seed,
verses.17:13: shall surely be circumcised, the one born in your house and the one bought with silver. And My covenant will be on your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.17:14: And an uncircumcised male, who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin on the eighth day, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from his people, because he has broken My covenant."
verses.17:15: And God said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, her name will not be called Sarai, but Sarah will be her name.
verses.17:16: And I will bless her, and I will give you a child from her. And I will bless him, and he will become nations, and kings of nations will be from him."
verses.17:17: And Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and spoke in his mind, saying, "Will a son be born to a hundred-year-old man, and will one be born to Sarah at ninety years old?"
verses.17:18: And Abraham said to God, "Let this Ishmael live before You."
verses.17:19: And God said to Abraham, "Yes; look, Sarah your wife will bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac; and I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and for his seed after him.
verses.17:20: Now concerning Ishmael, look, I have heard you; and I have blessed him, and I will increase him and multiply him exceedingly; he will father twelve nations, and I will make him into a great nation.
verses.17:21: But My covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time in the next year."
verses.17:22: And He finished speaking to him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.17:23: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all those born in his house, and all those bought with silver, and every male of the men who were in the house of Abraham, and circumcised their foreskins at the time of that day, just as God had spoken to him.
verses.17:24: Now Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin;
verses.17:25: and Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.17:26: At the time of that day, Abraham and Ishmael his son were circumcised;
verses.17:27: and all the men of his house, both those born in the house and those bought with silver from foreign nations—he circumcised them.
verses.18:1: Now God appeared to him by the oak of Mamre, while he was sitting at the door of his tent at midday.
verses.18:2: And looking up with his eyes, he saw, and look, three men were standing above him. And when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the door of his tent, and bowed down to the ground;
verses.18:3: and he said, "Lord, if indeed I have found favor before You, do not pass by Your servant.
verses.18:4: Please let water be fetched, and let someone wash your feet, and cool yourselves under the tree.
verses.18:5: And I will fetch bread, and you shall eat; and after this you may pass on along your way, since for this reason you have turned aside to your servant." And He said, "Do so, just as you have said."
verses.18:6: And Abraham hurried to the tent to Sarah and said to her, "Hurry and knead three measures of fine flour and make hearth cakes."
verses.18:7: And Abraham ran to the cattle, and they took a tender and good calf, and he gave it to the servant, and he hurried to prepare it.
verses.18:8: And he took butter and milk and the calf that he had prepared, and set them before them, and they ate; and he himself stood beside them under the tree.
verses.18:9: And He said to him, "Where is Sarah your wife?" And answering, he said, "Here, in the tent."
verses.18:10: And He said, "Returning, I will come to you at this time in due season, and Sarah your wife will have a son." Now Sarah heard at the door of the tent, being behind Him.
verses.18:11: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in days; and the manner of women had ceased to happen to Sarah.
verses.18:12: And Sarah laughed within herself, saying, "It has not yet happened to me until now, but my lord is old."
verses.18:13: And the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh within herself, saying, 'Will I truly give birth? Yet I have grown old'?
verses.18:14: Is any matter impossible with God? At this time I will return to you in due season, and Sarah will have a son."
verses.18:15: And Sarah denied it, saying, "I did not laugh," for she was afraid. And He said, "No, but you did laugh."
verses.18:16: Then the men rose up from there and looked down toward the face of Sodom and Gomorrah; and Abraham was walking with them, sending them on their way.
verses.18:17: And the Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham My servant the things that I am doing?
verses.18:18: Now Abraham will surely become a great and numerous nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him.
verses.18:19: For I knew that he will command his sons and his house after him, and they will guard the ways of the Lord, to do righteousness and justice, so that the Lord may bring upon Abraham all the things that He has spoken concerning him."
verses.18:20: And the Lord said, "The outcry of Sodom and Gomorrah has been multiplied, and their sins are exceedingly great.
verses.18:21: Therefore I will go down and see whether they are acting to the full according to their outcry that is coming to Me; and if not, so that I may know."
verses.18:22: And turning away from there, the men went to Sodom; but Abraham was standing before the Lord.
verses.18:23: And Abraham drew near and said, "Do not destroy a righteous person together with an ungodly person, and the righteous will be like the ungodly.
verses.18:24: If there are fifty righteous people in the city, will You destroy them? Will You not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous people, if they are in it?
verses.18:25: By no means shall You act like this matter, to kill a righteous person with an ungodly person, and the righteous will be like the ungodly; by no means. You who judge all the earth, will You not do justice?"
verses.18:26: And the Lord said, "If I find in Sodom fifty righteous people in the city, I will spare the whole place on their account."
verses.18:27: And answering, Abraham said, "Now I have begun to speak to the Lord, though I am earth and ashes;
verses.18:28: now if the fifty righteous people are fewer by five, will You destroy the whole city because of the five?" And He said, "I will certainly not destroy it if I find forty-five there."
verses.18:29: And he continued yet further to speak to Him and said, "What if forty are found there?" And He said, "I will certainly not destroy it for the sake of the forty."
verses.18:30: And he said, "Let it be nothing, Lord, if I speak; what if thirty are found there?" And He said, "I will certainly not destroy it if thirty are found there."
verses.18:31: And he said, "Since I am able to speak to the Lord, what if twenty are found there?" And He said, "I will certainly not destroy it for the sake of the twenty."
verses.18:32: And he said, "Let it be nothing, Lord, if I speak just once more; what if ten are found there?" And He said, "I will certainly not destroy it for the sake of the ten."
verses.18:33: And the Lord departed when He stopped speaking to Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
verses.19:1: Now the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting beside the gate of Sodom. When Lot saw them, he rose up to meet them and bowed down with his face to the ground.
verses.19:2: And he said, "Look, lords, turn aside to the house of your servant and stay the night, and wash your feet; and rising early, you will depart on your way." But they said, "No, rather we will stay the night in the square."
verses.19:3: And he strongly urged them, and they turned aside to him. And they entered into his house, and he made a banquet for them and baked unleavened loaves for them, and they ate
verses.19:4: before lying down. And the men of the city, the Sodomites, surrounded the house, from young man to old man, all the people together.
verses.19:5: And they were calling out for Lot and saying to him, "Where are the men who came in to you during the night? Bring them out to us, so that we may have relations with them."
verses.19:6: Then Lot went out to them, and shut the door behind him.
verses.19:7: And he said to them, "By no means, brothers, do not act wickedly.
verses.19:8: Now I have two daughters who have not known a man; I will bring them out to you, and treat them as it pleases you; only do nothing unjust to these men, because they have come under the shelter of my roof beams."
verses.19:9: But they said, "Stand back over there! You came in to reside as a foreigner; surely not also to pass judgment? Now therefore we will harm you more than them." And they pressed very hard against the man, Lot, and came near to break down the door.
verses.19:10: But the men reached out their hands and pulled Lot inside to themselves into the house, and shut the door of the house.
verses.19:11: And the men who were at the door of the house they struck with blindness, from small to great; and they became exhausted searching for the door.
verses.19:12: Then the men said to Lot, "Do you have anyone here—sons-in-law, or sons, or daughters, or if you have anyone else in the city—bring them out of this place,
verses.19:13: because we are destroying this place, since their outcry has risen high before the Lord, and the Lord has sent us to wipe it out."
verses.19:14: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law who had taken his daughters, and said, "Get up and go out from this place, because the Lord is wiping out the city." But he seemed to be joking before his sons-in-law.
verses.19:15: Now when dawn was coming, the angels were hurrying Lot, saying, "Get up, take your wife and your two daughters whom you have, and go out, so that you do not perish together with the lawless deeds of the city."
verses.19:16: And they were troubled; and the angels took hold of their hand, and the hand of his wife, and the hands of his two daughters, because the Lord spared him.
verses.19:17: And it happened, when they had brought them outside, that they said, "Be sure to save your own life; do not look around behind you, nor stop in all the surrounding region; get to safety in the mountain, so that you are not swept away with them."
verses.19:18: And Lot said to them, "I beg you, lord,
verses.19:19: since your servant has found mercy before you, and you have magnified your righteousness, which you are doing toward me, so that my soul may live; yet I will not be able to reach safety in the mountain, for fear that the evils overtake me and I die;
verses.19:20: look, this city is near for me to flee there, which is small; there I will be saved. Is it not small? And my soul will live because of you."
verses.19:21: And he said to him, "Look, I have shown regard for your face in this matter also, so as not to overthrow the city about which you spoke;
verses.19:22: hurry, therefore, to reach safety there; for I will not be able to do anything until you arrive there." Therefore he named the name of that city Zoar.
verses.19:23: The sun came out upon the earth, and Lot entered into Zoar,
verses.19:24: and the Lord rained upon Sodom and Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the Lord out of heaven,
verses.19:25: and He overthrew these cities in which Lot was dwelling, and all the surrounding region, and all those dwelling in the cities, and all things springing up from the earth.
verses.19:26: And his wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.19:27: Now Abraham rose early in the morning to go to the place where he had stood before the Lord,
verses.19:28: and looked toward the face of Sodom and Gomorrah and toward the face of the land of the surrounding region, and he saw; and look, a flame of the earth was rising up like the vapor of a furnace.
verses.19:29: And it happened, when the Lord wiped out all the cities of the surrounding region, that God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out from the midst of the overthrow, when the Lord overthrew the cities in which Lot was dwelling.
verses.19:30: And Lot went out from Zoar and settled in the mountain, and his two daughters with him, for he was afraid to dwell in Zoar; and he dwelt in the cave, he and his two daughters with him.
verses.19:31: Then the older one said to the younger one, "Our father is old, and there is no one on the earth who will come in to us as is fitting for all the earth.
verses.19:32: Come, therefore, let us give our father wine to drink and let us lie with him, and let us raise up seed from our father."
verses.19:33: So they gave their father wine to drink on that night, and the older one went in and lay with her father during that night; and he did not know when she lay down or when she rose up.
verses.19:34: And it happened on the next day that the older one said to the younger one, "Look, yesterday I lay with our father; let us give him wine to drink this night also, and go in and lie with him, and let us raise up seed from our father."
verses.19:35: So on that night also they gave their father wine to drink, and the younger one went in and lay with her father; and he did not know when she lay down or when she rose up.
verses.19:36: And the two daughters of Lot conceived by their father.
verses.19:37: And the older one gave birth to a son, and called his name Moab, saying, "From my father." He is the father of the Moabites to the present day.
verses.19:38: And the younger one also gave birth to a son, and called his name Amman, the son of my kindred; he is the father of the Ammanites to the present day.
verses.20:1: And Abraham moved from there to a land toward the south, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur; and he resided as a foreigner in Gerar.
verses.20:2: And Abraham said concerning Sarah his wife, "She is my sister"; for he was afraid to say, "She is my wife," for fear that the men of the city might kill him on account of her. Then Abimelech, king of Gerar, sent and took Sarah.
verses.20:3: And God came in to Abimelech in his sleep at night, and said to him, "Look, you are about to die because of the woman whom you took, for she is married to a husband."
verses.20:4: Now Abimelech had not touched her, and he said, "Lord, will You destroy an unwitting and righteous nation?
verses.20:5: Did he himself not say to me, 'She is my sister'? And she said to me, 'He is my brother.' With a pure heart and with righteousness of hands I have done this."
verses.20:6: And God said to him in his sleep, "I also knew that you did this with a pure heart, and I Myself spared you from sinning against Me; because of this I did not allow you to touch her.
verses.20:7: Now, however, return the wife to the man, because he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live; but if you do not return her, know that you will die, you and all that is yours."
verses.20:8: And Abimelech rose early in the morning and called all his servants, and spoke all these words in their ears; and all the people were exceedingly afraid.
verses.20:9: Then Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, "What is this you have done to us? Have we sinned against you in any way, that you have brought a great sin upon me and upon my kingdom? You have done to me a deed that no one will do."
verses.20:10: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "What did you see that you did this?"
verses.20:11: And Abraham said, "Because I said, 'Surely there is no reverence for God in this place, and they will kill me on account of my wife.'
verses.20:12: And indeed, truly she is my sister by my father, though not by my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.20:13: And it happened, when God brought me out from the house of my father, that I said to her, 'Do this righteousness toward me: in every place wherever we enter, say concerning me, "He is my brother."'"
verses.20:14: Then Abimelech took a thousand didrachmas, sheep and calves and male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abram; and he returned Sarah his wife to him.
verses.20:15: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "Look, my land is before you; dwell wherever it pleases you."
verses.20:16: And to Sarah he said, "Look, I have given a thousand didrachmas to your brother; these will be to you for the honor of your face and for all the women with you; and in all things speak the truth."
verses.20:17: And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his female servants, and they gave birth;
verses.20:18: because the Lord had closed up every womb from the outside in the house of Abimelech on account of Sarah, the wife of Abraham.
verses.21:1: And the Lord visited Sarah, just as He had said; and the Lord did for Sarah just as He had spoken.
verses.21:2: And having conceived, Sarah bore a son to Abraham in old age, at the time just as the Lord had spoken to him.
verses.21:3: And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
verses.21:4: And Abraham circumcised Isaac on the eighth day, just as God had commanded him.
verses.21:5: Now Abraham was one hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
verses.21:6: And Sarah said, "The Lord has made laughter for me; for whoever hears will rejoice with me."
verses.21:7: And she said, "Who will report to Abraham that Sarah is nursing a child? For I have borne a son in my old age."
verses.21:8: And the child grew and was weaned; and Abraham made a great feast on the day on which his son Isaac was weaned.
verses.21:9: Now Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, who was born to Abraham, playing with her own son Isaac,
verses.21:10: and she said to Abraham, "Cast out this maidservant and her son; for the son of the maidservant will certainly not inherit with my son Isaac."
verses.21:11: And the matter appeared very harsh before Abraham concerning his son Ishmael.
verses.21:12: But God said to Abraham, "Do not let the matter be harsh before you concerning the child and concerning the maidservant; whatever Sarah says to you, listen to her voice, because in Isaac seed will be called for you.
verses.21:13: And as for the son of this maidservant also, I will make him into a great nation, because he is your seed."
verses.21:14: So Abraham rose in the morning, and took loaves of bread and a skin of water and gave them to Hagar, and placed them on her shoulder along with the child, and sent her away. And departing, she wandered in the wilderness near the Well of the Oath.
verses.21:15: And the water ran out from the skin, and she cast the child under one fir tree.
verses.21:16: And going away, she sat opposite him farther off, about a bowshot away; for she said, "I will certainly not see the death of my child." And she sat opposite him at a distance; and crying out, the child wept.
verses.21:17: And God heard the voice of the child from the place where he was, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, "What is the matter, Hagar? Do not be afraid, for God has listened to the voice of your child from the place where he is.
verses.21:18: Get up and take the child, and hold him firmly with your hand; for I will make him into a great nation."
verses.21:19: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of living water; and she went and filled the skin with water and gave the child a drink.
verses.21:20: And God was with the child, and he grew up and lived in the wilderness; and he became an archer.
verses.21:21: And he lived in the wilderness, and his mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
verses.21:22: Now it happened at that time that Abimelech, along with Ahuzzath his bridal attendant and Phicol the commander of his army, spoke to Abraham, saying, "God is with you in everything that you do.
verses.21:23: Now therefore, swear to me by God that you will not wrong me, nor my seed, nor my name; but according to the righteousness that I have done with you, you will do with me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner."
verses.21:25: And Abraham reproved Abimelech concerning the wells of water that the servants of Abimelech had seized.
verses.21:26: And Abimelech said to him, "I did not know who did this thing; neither did you tell me, nor did I hear of it except today."
verses.21:27: And Abraham took sheep and calves and gave them to Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
verses.21:28: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.21:29: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "What are the seven ewe lambs of these sheep that you set by themselves?"
verses.21:30: And Abraham said, "You will receive these seven ewe lambs from me, so that they may be a witness that I dug this well."
verses.21:31: Therefore he named the name of that place Well of Swearing, because there both of them swore.
verses.21:32: And they made a covenant at the Well of the Oath. Then Abimelech rose up, along with Ahuzzath his bridal attendant and Phicol the commander of his army, and they returned to the land of the Philistines.
verses.21:33: And Abraham planted a field at the Well of the Oath, and called there on the name of the Lord, Eternal God.
verses.21:34: And Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
verses.22:1: And it happened after these things that God tested Abraham, and said to him, "Abraham, Abraham." And he said, "Here I am."
verses.22:2: And He said, "Take your beloved son, whom you have loved, Isaac, and go to the high land, and offer him up there as a whole burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you."
verses.22:3: So Abraham rose in the morning and saddled his donkey. And he took with him two servants and Isaac his son, and having split wood for a whole burnt offering, he rose and went. And he came to the place of which God had told him on the third day.
verses.22:4: And Abraham looked up with his eyes and saw the place from a distance.
verses.22:5: And Abraham said to his servants, "Sit here with the donkey, while I and the child go over there; and having worshiped, we will return to you."
verses.22:6: And Abraham took the wood of the whole burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son; and he also took the fire in his hand and the knife, and the two of them went together.
verses.22:7: And Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, saying, "Father." And he said, "What is it, child?" And he said, "Look, the fire and the wood; where is the sheep for the whole burnt offering?"
verses.22:8: And Abraham said, "God will see for Himself a sheep for a whole burnt offering, child." And both of them, going together,
verses.22:9: came to the place of which God had told him. And there Abraham built an altar and laid the wood on it; and having bound the feet of Isaac his son, he laid him on the altar on top of the wood.
verses.22:10: And Abraham stretched out his hand to take the knife, to slaughter his son.
verses.22:11: And the angel of the Lord called to him from heaven and said to him, "Abraham, Abraham." And he said, "Here I am."
verses.22:12: And he said, "Do not lay your hand on the boy, nor do anything to him; for now I know that you fear God, and have not spared your beloved son because of Me."
