verses.22:13: And Abraham looked up with his eyes and saw, and look, one ram caught by its horns in a sabek plant. And Abraham went and took the ram, and offered it up as a whole burnt offering in place of Isaac his son.
verses.22:14: And Abraham called the name of that place, "The Lord Saw," so that they say today, "On the mountain the Lord appeared."
verses.22:15: And the angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time from heaven,
verses.22:16: saying, "By Myself I have sworn, says the Lord: because you have done this thing and have not spared your beloved son because of Me,
verses.22:17: surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply your seed like the stars of heaven and like the sand along the shore of the sea; and your seed will inherit the cities of the adversaries.
verses.22:18: and in your seed all the nations will be blessed, because you obeyed My voice."
verses.22:19: So Abraham returned to his servants, and rising up, they went to the Well of the Oath; and Abraham lived at the Well of the Oath.
verses.22:20: Now it happened after these things that it was reported to Abraham, saying, "Look, Milcah also has borne sons to your brother Nahor:
verses.22:21: Uz the firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of the Syrians,
verses.22:22: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel."
verses.22:23: And Bethuel fathered Rebekah. These are the eight sons whom Milcah bore to Nahor, the brother of Abraham.
verses.22:24: And his concubine, whose name was Reera, also bore Tebah, and Taam, and Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.23:1: Now the life of Sarah was one hundred twenty-seven years.
verses.23:2: And Sarah died in the city of Arbok, which is in the valley; this is Hebron in the land of Canaan. And Abraham came to lament for Sarah and to mourn.
verses.23:3: And Abraham rose up from his dead, and Abraham spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.23:4: "I am a resident alien and a temporary resident with you; therefore give me a possession for a grave with you, and I will bury my dead there."
verses.23:5: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying,
verses.23:6: "No, lord; instead, listen to us. You are a king from God among us; bury your dead in our choice tombs, for none of us will withhold his tomb from you for burying your dead there."
verses.23:7: Then Abraham rose up and bowed down to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.
verses.23:8: And Abraham spoke to them, saying, "If you have it in your soul to bury my dead from before my face, listen to me and speak concerning me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.23:9: and let him give me the double cave that belongs to him, which is in a portion of his field; for its worth in silver, give it to me among you as a possession for a tomb."
verses.23:10: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the sons of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered and spoke to Abraham, in the hearing of the sons of Heth and of all who were entering the city, saying,
verses.23:11: "Be with me, lord, and listen to me. The field and the cave that is in it I give to you; before my citizens I have given it to you; bury your dead."
verses.23:12: And Abraham bowed down before the people of the land.
verses.23:13: And he spoke to Ephron within hearing before all the people of the land, "Since you are on my side, listen to me: take the silver for the field from me, and bury my dead there."
verses.23:15: "No, lord, for I have heard: four hundred didrachmas of silver—between me and you, what would this be? But you, bury your dead."
verses.23:16: And Abraham listened to Ephron; and Abraham paid to Ephron the silver which he had spoken in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred didrachmas of silver, approved by merchants.
verses.23:17: And the field of Ephron stood confirmed, which was in the double cave, which is facing Mamre—the field and the cave that belonged to it, and every tree that was in the field, which is within its borders all around—
verses.23:18: to Abraham as a possession before the sons of Heth and all who were entering the city.
verses.23:19: After these things, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the double cave of the field, which is opposite Mamre; this is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
verses.23:20: And the field and the cave that belonged to it were ratified to Abraham as a possession for a grave from the sons of Heth.
verses.24:1: Now Abraham was old, advanced in days, and the Lord blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.24:2: And Abraham said to his servant, the oldest of his household, who ruled over all that was his, "Put your hand under my thigh,
verses.24:3: and I will make you swear by the Lord, the God of heaven and of the earth, that you will not take a wife for my son Isaac from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell;
verses.24:4: but you will go to my land where I was born and to my tribe, and you will take a wife for my son Isaac from there."
verses.24:5: And the servant said to him, "Perhaps the woman will not be willing to go back with me to this land. Should I take your son back to the land from which you came out?"
verses.24:6: And Abraham said to him, "Be careful that you do not take my son back there.
verses.24:7: The Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, who took me from my father's house and from the land where I was born, who spoke to me and swore to me, saying, 'To you I will give this land and to your seed,' He Himself will send His angel before you, and you will take a wife for my son Isaac from there.
verses.24:8: But if the woman is not willing to go with you to this land, you will be clear of this oath; only do not take my son back there."
verses.24:9: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
verses.24:10: And the servant took ten camels from his master's camels, and some of all his master's good things with him, and rising up, he went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
verses.24:11: And he made the camels lie down outside the city beside the well of water toward evening, at the time when the women who draw water come out.
verses.24:12: And he said, "Lord, the God of the master Abraham, grant success before me today, and show mercy to my master Abraham.
verses.24:13: Look, I am standing at the spring of water, and the daughters of those who dwell in the city are coming out to draw water.
verses.24:14: And let it be that the young woman to whom I say, 'Tilt your water jar so that I may drink,' and she says to me, 'You drink, and I will water your camels also until they finish drinking,' she is the one You have prepared for Your servant Isaac; and by this I will know that You have shown mercy to my master Abraham."
verses.24:15: And it happened, before he had finished speaking in his mind, that look, Rebekah was coming out, who was born to Bethuel, the son of Milcah the wife of Nahor, the brother of Abraham, with her water jar on her shoulders.
verses.24:16: Now the young woman was very beautiful in appearance; she was a virgin; no man had known her. And going down to the spring, she filled her water jar and came up.
verses.24:17: Then the servant ran to meet her and said, "Give me a little water to drink from your water jar."
verses.24:18: And she said, "Drink, lord." And she hurried and lowered the water jar onto her arm, and gave him a drink until he finished drinking.
verses.24:19: And she said, "I will draw water for your camels also until they have all drunk."
verses.24:20: And she hurried and emptied the water jar into the watering trough, and ran to the well to draw water, and drew water for all the camels.
verses.24:21: Meanwhile, the man was observing her closely, and kept silent in order to know whether the Lord had made his way successful or not.
verses.24:22: And it happened, when all the camels had finished drinking, that the man took gold earrings, each a drachma in weight, and two bracelets for her hands; their weight was ten gold pieces.
verses.24:23: And he questioned her and said, "Whose daughter are you? Tell me: is there a place with your father for us to lodge?"
verses.24:24: And she said to him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, whom she bore to him, Nahor."
verses.24:25: And she said to him, "Both straw and much fodder are with us, and a place to lodge."
verses.24:26: And being pleased, the man worshiped the Lord and said,
verses.24:27: "Blessed is the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken righteousness and truth from my master; as for me, the Lord has led me successfully to the house of my master's brother."
verses.24:28: And the girl ran and reported to her mother's house according to these words.
verses.24:29: Now Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban; and Laban ran out to the man at the spring.
verses.24:30: And it happened, when he saw the earrings and the bracelets on his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, "Thus the man has spoken to me," that he came to the man as he was standing by the camels at the spring;
verses.24:31: and he said to him, "Come, enter! Blessed is the Lord. Why are you standing outside? For I have prepared the house and a place for the camels."
verses.24:32: So the man entered the house, and he unloaded the camels; and he gave straw and fodder to the camels, and water for his feet and for the feet of the men who were with him,
verses.24:33: and he set loaves of bread before them to eat. And he said, "I will certainly not eat until I have spoken my words." And they said, "Speak."
verses.24:34: And he said, "I am Abraham's servant.
verses.24:35: And the Lord has blessed my master greatly, and he has been exalted; and He has given him sheep and calves, and silver and gold, male servants and female servants, camels and donkeys.
verses.24:36: And Sarah, my master's wife, bore one son to my master after he had grown old; and he has given to him all that was his.
verses.24:37: And my master made me swear, saying, 'You will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I sojourn in their land;
verses.24:38: but you will go to my father's house and to my tribe, and you will take a wife for my son from there.'
verses.24:39: And I said to my master, 'Perhaps the woman will not go with me.'
verses.24:40: And he said to me, 'The Lord God, before whom I have been well-pleasing, He Himself will send out His angel with you and will make your way successful; and you will take a wife for my son from my tribe and from my father's house.
verses.24:41: Then you will be guiltless of my curse; for when you come to my tribe and they do not give her to you, then you will be guiltless of my oath.'
verses.24:42: And coming today to the spring, I said, 'Lord, the God of my master Abraham, if You are making my way successful, on which I am now going,
verses.24:43: look, I am standing at the spring of water, and the daughters of the people of the city will come out to draw water; and let it be that the young woman to whom I say, "Give me a little water to drink from your water jar,"
verses.24:44: and she says to me, "You drink, and I will draw water for your camels also," she is the woman whom the Lord has prepared for His own servant Isaac; and by this I will know that You have shown mercy to my master Abraham.'
verses.24:45: And it happened, before I had finished speaking in my mind, immediately Rebekah was coming out with the water jar on her shoulders, and she went down to the spring and drew water. And I said to her, 'Give me a drink.'
verses.24:46: And hurrying, she lowered the water jar from herself onto her arm and said, 'You drink, and I will water your camels also.' So I drank, and she watered my camels.
verses.24:47: And I asked her and said, 'Whose daughter are you? Tell me.' And she said, 'I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.' And I put the earrings on her, and the bracelets on her hands;
verses.24:48: and being pleased, I worshiped the Lord, and blessed the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who led me successfully in the way of truth to take the daughter of my master's brother for his son.
verses.24:49: Therefore, if you are showing mercy and righteousness toward my master, tell me, so that I may turn to the right or to the left."
verses.24:50: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, "This decree has come out from the Lord; therefore we will not be able to speak against you evil for good.
verses.24:51: Look, Rebekah is before you; take her and hurry off, and let her be a wife to your master's son, just as the Lord has spoken."
verses.24:52: And it happened, when the servant of Abraham heard these words, that he bowed down to the ground in worship to the Lord.
verses.24:53: And the servant brought out articles of silver and gold and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah; and he gave gifts to her brother and to her mother.
verses.24:54: And they ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and they slept. And rising up in the morning, he said, "Send me away so that I may depart to my master."
verses.24:55: But her brothers and her mother said, "Let the young woman stay with us about ten days, and after that she will depart."
verses.24:56: And he said to them, "Do not detain me, since the Lord has made my way successful; send me away so that I may depart to my master."
verses.24:57: And they said, "Let us call the girl and question her mouth."
verses.24:58: And they called Rebekah and said to her, "Will you go with this man?" And she said, "I will go."
verses.24:59: So they sent away Rebekah their sister and her possessions, and the servant of Abraham and those with him.
verses.24:60: And they blessed Rebekah their sister and said to her, "You are our sister; become thousands of ten thousands, and may your seed inherit the cities of the adversaries."
verses.24:61: Then Rebekah and her maidservants arose and mounted the camels, and went with the man; and the servant took Rebekah and departed.
verses.24:62: Now Isaac was journeying through the wilderness by the Well of Vision; and he was dwelling in the land toward the south.
verses.24:63: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field toward evening; and looking up with his eyes, he saw camels coming.
verses.24:64: And Rebekah, looking up with her eyes, saw Isaac and leaped down from the camel,
verses.24:65: and she said to the servant, "Who is that man walking in the field to meet us?" And the servant said, "This is my master." So she took the veil and wrapped herself in it.
verses.24:66: And the servant recounted to Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.24:67: Then Isaac entered the house of his mother, and he took Rebekah, and she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted concerning Sarah his mother.
verses.25:1: Now Abraham again took a wife, whose name was Keturah.
verses.25:2: And she bore to him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.25:3: And Jokshan fathered Sheba, Teman, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Reuel, Nabdeel, Asshurim, Datusieim, and Leummim.
verses.25:4: And the sons of Midian were Gephar, Epher, Hanoch, Abira, and Thergama. All these were sons of Keturah.
verses.25:5: Now Abraham gave all his possessions to Isaac his son.
verses.25:6: And to the sons of his concubines Abraham gave gifts, and he sent them away from Isaac his son while he was still living, eastward to the land of the east.
verses.25:7: And these are the years of the days of Abraham's life that he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
verses.25:8: And expiring, Abraham died in a good old age, an old man and full of days, and he was added to his people.
verses.25:9: And Isaac and Ishmael, his two sons, buried him in the double cave, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is opposite Mamre,
verses.25:10: the field and the cave that Abraham acquired from the sons of Heth; there they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife.
verses.25:11: And it came about after Abraham died that God blessed Isaac his son; and Isaac settled beside the Well of Vision.
verses.25:12: Now these are the generations of Ishmael the son of Abraham, whom Hagar, the female servant of Sarah, bore to Abraham.
verses.25:13: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, according to the name of his generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Nabdeel, and Mibsam,
verses.25:14: and Mishma, and Iduma, and Massa,
verses.25:15: and Choddan, and Teman, and Jetur, and Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.25:16: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names in their tents and in their encampments: twelve rulers according to their nation.
verses.25:17: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. And expiring, he died and was added to his kindred.
verses.25:18: And he settled from Havilah as far as Suel, which is facing Egypt, until one comes to the Assyrians; facing all his brothers he settled.
verses.25:19: And these are the generations of Isaac the son of Abraham: Abraham fathered Isaac.
verses.25:20: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel the Syrian from Mesopotamia, sister of Laban the Syrian, for himself as a wife.
verses.25:21: And Isaac pleaded with the Lord concerning Rebekah his wife, because she was barren; and God listened to him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.25:22: And the children were leaping inside her; and she said, "If it is going to be this way for me, why is this happening to me?" And she went to inquire of the Lord.
verses.25:23: And the Lord said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples will be separated from your belly; and one people will surpass the other people, and the greater will serve the lesser."
verses.25:24: And the days for her to give birth were fulfilled, and here there were twins in her womb.
verses.25:25: And the firstborn son came out reddish, completely hairy like a hide; and she gave him the name Esau.
verses.25:26: And after this his brother came out, and his hand was grasping Esau's heel; and she called his name Jacob. Now Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah bore them.
verses.25:27: And the young men grew up; and Esau was a man who knew how to hunt, a man of the fields, while Jacob was a plain man, living in a house.
verses.25:28: And Isaac loved Esau, because his game was food for him; but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.25:29: Now Jacob cooked a stew, and Esau came from the field, fainting.
verses.25:30: And Esau said to Jacob, "Give me a taste of this red stew, for I am fainting." Therefore his name was called Edom.
verses.25:31: And Jacob said to Esau, "Sell me today your birthright, to me."
verses.25:32: And Esau said, "Look, I am going to die, so what is this birthright to me?"
verses.25:33: And Jacob said to him, "Swear to me today." And he swore to him; and Esau sold the birthright to Jacob.
verses.25:34: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew; and he ate and drank, and got up and went away. Thus Esau despised the birthright.
verses.26:1: Now a famine occurred on the land, apart from the earlier famine that happened in the time of Abraham; and Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, to Gerar.
verses.26:2: And the Lord appeared to him and said, "Do not go down to Egypt; rather, settle in the land that I tell you.
verses.26:3: And sojourn in this land, and I will be with you and bless you; for to you and to your seed I will give all this land, and I will establish My oath that I swore to Abraham your father.
verses.26:4: And I will multiply your seed like the stars of heaven, and I will give to your seed all this land, and in your seed all the nations of the earth will be blessed,
verses.26:5: because Abraham your father obeyed My voice and kept My ordinances and My commandments and My statutes and My laws."
verses.26:7: And the men of the place asked about Rebekah his wife, and he said, "She is my sister," for he was afraid to say, "She is my wife," for fear that the men of the place might kill him on account of Rebekah, because she was beautiful in appearance.
verses.26:8: And he stayed there a long time; and Abimelech the king of Gerar, peering through the window, saw Isaac playing with Rebekah his wife.
verses.26:9: And Abimelech called Isaac and said to him, "So then, she is your wife! Why did you say, 'She is my sister'?" And Isaac said to him, "Because I said, 'I might die on account of her.'"
verses.26:10: And Abimelech said to him, "What is this you have done to us? One of my kindred nearly slept with your wife, and you would have brought ignorance upon us."
verses.26:11: And Abimelech commanded all his people, saying, "Everyone who touches this man or his wife will be liable to death."
verses.26:12: And Isaac sowed in that land, and in that year he found a hundredfold of barley; and the Lord blessed him.
verses.26:13: And the man was exalted, and advancing he kept becoming greater until he became very great.
verses.26:14: And he had livestock of sheep and livestock of cattle and many tilled fields; and the Philistines envied him.
verses.26:15: And all the wells that the servants of his father had dug in the time of his father, the Philistines stopped them up and filled them with earth.
verses.26:16: And Abimelech said to Isaac, "Depart from us, because you have become much more powerful than we."
verses.26:17: And Isaac departed from there and encamped in the valley of Gerar, and settled there.
verses.26:18: And Isaac again dug the wells of water that the servants of Abraham his father had dug, and which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham his father died; and he gave them names according to the names that Abraham his father had named them.
verses.26:19: And the servants of Isaac dug in the valley of Gerar, and found there a well of living water.
verses.26:20: And the shepherds of Gerar quarreled with the shepherds of Isaac, claiming that the water was theirs; and he called the name of that well Injustice, for they treated him unjustly.
verses.26:21: And departing from there, Isaac dug another well; and they disputed about that one also, and he gave it the name Enmity.
verses.26:22: And departing from there, he dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it; and he gave it the name Broad Space, saying, "Because now the Lord has made room for us and has increased us on the land."
verses.26:23: And he went up from there to the Well of the Oath.
verses.26:24: And the Lord appeared to him in that night and said, "I am the God of Abraham your father. Do not be afraid, for I am with you, and I will bless you and multiply your seed for the sake of Abraham your father."
verses.26:25: And he built an altar there and called upon the name of the Lord, and he pitched his tent there; and there the servants of Isaac dug a well.
verses.26:26: And Abimelech went to him from Gerar, along with Ahuzzath his bridal attendant and Phicol the commander of his army.
verses.26:27: And Isaac said to them, "Why have you come to me? Yet you hated me and sent me away from you."
verses.26:28: And they said, "We have clearly seen that the Lord was with you, and we said, 'Let there be a curse between us and you, and we will make a covenant with you
verses.26:29: not to do evil to us, just as we did not detest you, and in the way we treated you well and sent you away with peace.' And now you are blessed by the Lord."
verses.26:30: And he made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
verses.26:31: And rising up in the morning, they swore each man to his neighbor; and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in safety.
verses.26:32: And it came about on that day that the servants of Isaac arrived and reported to him about the well that they had dug, and they said, "We did not find water."
verses.26:33: And he called its name Oath; therefore he called the name of the city Well of Oath, to the present day.
verses.26:34: Now Esau was forty years old, and he took as a wife Judith, daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, daughter of Elon the Hivite;
verses.26:35: and they were quarreling with Isaac and Rebekah.
verses.27:1: Now it came about, after Isaac had grown old, that his eyes grew too dim to see; and he called Esau, his older son, and said to him, "My son." And he said to him, "Here I am."
verses.27:2: And he said, "Look, I have grown old, and I do not know the day of my death.
verses.27:3: Now therefore, take your gear, both your quiver and your bow, and go out into the field and hunt game for me,
verses.27:4: and make savory dishes for me as I love, and bring them to me so that I may eat, in order that my soul may bless you before I die."
verses.27:5: Now Rebekah heard Isaac speaking to Esau his son. And Esau went into the field to hunt game for his father.
verses.27:6: And Rebekah said to Jacob, her younger son, "See, I heard your father speaking to Esau your brother, saying,
verses.27:7: 'Bring me game and make savory dishes for me, so that when I have eaten I may bless you before the Lord before I die.'
verses.27:8: Now therefore, son, listen to me just as I command you:
verses.27:9: go to the flock and take for me from there two tender and fine young goats, and I will make them into savory dishes for your father as he loves;
verses.27:10: and you will bring them in to your father and he will eat, in order that your father may bless you before he dies."
verses.27:11: Then Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "Esau my brother is a hairy man, while I am a smooth man.
verses.27:12: Perhaps my father will feel me, and I will be before him as one showing contempt, and I will bring a curse upon myself and not a blessing."
verses.27:13: And his mother said to him, "Upon me be your curse, child; only obey my voice, and go and bring them to me."
verses.27:14: So he went and took them and brought them to his mother, and his mother made savory dishes just as his father loved.
verses.27:15: Then Rebekah took the fine robe of Esau, her older son, which was with her in the house, and put it on Jacob, her younger son;
verses.27:16: and she put the skins of the young goats around his arms and over the bare parts of his neck;
verses.27:17: and she gave the savory dishes and the loaves of bread that she had made into the hands of Jacob her son.
verses.27:18: And he brought them in to his father, and said, "My father." And he said, "Here I am. Who are you, child?"
verses.27:19: And Jacob his son said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn. I have done just as you spoke to me. Rise, sit up, and eat of my game, so that your soul may bless me."
verses.27:20: And Isaac said to his son, "What is this that you have found so quickly, child?" And he said, "It is what the Lord God delivered before me."
verses.27:21: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Come near to me and I will feel you, child, whether you are my son Esau or not."
verses.27:22: So Jacob came near to Isaac his father, and he felt him and said, "The voice is the voice of Jacob, yet the hands are the hands of Esau."
verses.27:23: And he did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like the hands of his brother Esau; so he blessed him.
verses.27:24: And he said, "Are you my son Esau?" And he said, "I am."
verses.27:25: And he said, "Bring it to me and I will eat from your game, child, so that my soul may bless you." And he brought it to him, and he ate; and he brought wine in to him, and he drank.
verses.27:26: Then Isaac his father said to him, "Come near to me and kiss me, child."
verses.27:27: And he came near and kissed him. And he smelled the scent of his garments, and he blessed him and said, "Look, the scent of my son is like the scent of a full field that the Lord has blessed.
verses.27:28: And may God give you from the dew of heaven above, and from the richness of the earth, and an abundance of grain and wine.
verses.27:29: And let nations serve you, and rulers will bow down to you; and be lord over your brother, and the sons of your father will bow down to you. The one who curses you is cursed, and the one who blesses you is blessed."
verses.27:30: And it came about, after Isaac had finished blessing Jacob his son, and it came about as Jacob went out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.27:31: And he also made savory dishes and brought them to his father; and he said to his father, "Let my father rise and eat of his son's game, so that your soul may bless me."
verses.27:32: And Isaac his father said to him, "Who are you?" And he said, "I am your firstborn son, Esau."
verses.27:33: Then Isaac was struck with an exceedingly great astonishment and said, "Who then is the one who hunted game for me and brought it in to me, and I ate from all of it before you came in, and I blessed him? And let him be blessed."
verses.27:34: Now it came about, when Esau heard the words of Isaac his father, that Esau cried out with a loud and exceedingly bitter cry, and said, "Bless me too, please, father."
verses.27:35: And he said to him, "Your brother came with deceit and took your blessing."
verses.27:36: And he said, "Rightly was his name called Jacob, for he has tripped me up now this second time: he has taken my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing." And Esau said to his father, "Have you not kept back a blessing for me, father?"
verses.27:37: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, "If I have made him lord over you, and all his brothers I have made his household servants, and with grain and wine I have sustained him, then what will I do for you, child?"
verses.27:38: And Esau said to Isaac his father, "Do you have only one blessing, father? Bless me too, please, father."
verses.27:39: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, "Look, from the richness of the earth will be your dwelling, and from the dew of heaven above;
verses.27:40: and by your sword you will live, and you will serve your brother. Yet it will come about that whenever you tear down, you will also loosen his yoke from your neck."
verses.27:41: And Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing with which his father had blessed him. And Esau said in his mind, "Let the days of mourning for my father draw near, so that I may kill Jacob my brother."
verses.27:42: Now the words of Esau, her older son, were reported to Rebekah; so she sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, "Look, Esau your brother is threatening you to kill you.
verses.27:43: Now therefore, child, listen to my voice, and rise and flee to Mesopotamia, to Laban my brother, to Haran,
verses.27:44: and stay with him for some days, until the fury
verses.27:45: and the anger of your brother turn away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him; then I will send and summon you from there, so that I may not be made childless of both of you in a single day."
verses.27:46: And Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am disgusted with my life because of the daughters of the sons of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife from the daughters of this land, what is living to me?"
verses.28:1: Then Isaac summoned Jacob and blessed him, and commanded him, saying, "You must not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.
verses.28:2: Rise, flee to Mesopotamia of Syria, to the house of Bethuel, your mother's father, and take for yourself from there a wife from the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother.
verses.28:3: And may my God bless you and make you grow and multiply you, and you will become assemblies of nations;
verses.28:4: and may He give you the blessing of Abraham your father, to you and to your seed after you, to inherit the land of your sojourning, which God has given to Abraham."
verses.28:5: So Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Mesopotamia, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.28:6: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and that he had departed to Mesopotamia of Syria to take a wife for himself, as he blessed him and commanded him, saying, "You must not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,"
verses.28:7: and that Jacob listened to his father and his mother and went to Mesopotamia.
verses.28:8: And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were displeasing before Isaac his father,
verses.28:9: so Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael the son of Abraham, the sister of Nebaioth, as a wife in addition to his wives.
verses.28:10: And Jacob went out from the Well of the Oath and went toward Haran.
verses.28:11: And he came upon a place and lay down to sleep there, for the sun had set; and he took one of the stones of the place and put it at his head, and he lay down to sleep in that place.
verses.28:12: And he dreamed, and look, a ladder was fixed on the earth, whose top reached into heaven; and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
verses.28:13: And the Lord stood firmly upon it and said, "I am the God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac. Do not be afraid: the land on which you are sleeping, to you I will give it and to your seed.
verses.28:14: And your seed will be like the sand of the sea, and will spread out toward the sea and toward the south and toward the north and toward the east; and in you all the tribes of the earth will be blessed, and in your seed.
verses.28:15: And look, I am with you, guarding you along the entire way wherever you may go, and I will bring you back to this land; for I will by no means forsake you until I have done all that I have spoken to you."
verses.28:16: Then Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, "The Lord is in this place, and I did not know it."
verses.28:17: And he was afraid and said, "How fearful is this place! This is nothing other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven."
verses.28:18: And Jacob rose in the morning, and took the stone that he had put there at his head and set it up as a pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.
verses.28:19: And Jacob called the name of that place House of God; and Oulammaus was the name of the city previously.
verses.28:20: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, "If the Lord God is with me, and guards me on this way that I am going, and gives me bread to eat and a garment to put on,
verses.28:21: and brings me back in safety to the house of my father, then the Lord will be God to me;
verses.28:22: and this stone, which I have set up as a pillar, will be a house of God to me; and of all things that You may give me, I will surely tithe a tenth of them to You."
verses.29:1: And Jacob lifted up his feet and went to the land of the east, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.29:2: And he looked, and see, there was a well in the plain; and there were three flocks of sheep resting there together, for from that well they used to water the flocks, and a large stone was on the mouth of the well.
verses.29:3: And all the flocks would be gathered there, and they would roll the stone away from the mouth of the well, and water the sheep, and put the stone back on the mouth of the well in its place.
verses.29:4: And Jacob said to them, "Brothers, where are you from?" And they said, "We are from Haran."
verses.29:5: And he said to them, "Do you know Laban the son of Nahor?" And they said, "We know him."
verses.29:6: And he said to them, "Is he well?" And they said, "He is well." While he was still speaking, look, Rachel his daughter was coming with her father's sheep, for she herself was pasturing her father's sheep.
verses.29:7: And Jacob said, "There is still much day left; it is not yet time for the livestock to be gathered. Water the sheep, and go pasture them."
verses.29:8: And they said, "We will not be able to until all the shepherds are gathered and they roll the stone away from the mouth of the well, and we will water the sheep."
verses.29:9: While he was still speaking to them, Rachel the daughter of Laban was coming with her father's sheep, for she herself was pasturing her father's sheep.
verses.29:10: And it happened when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother's brother, that Jacob came near and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well, and watered the sheep of Laban, his mother's brother.
verses.29:11: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and cried out with his voice and wept.
verses.29:12: And he told Rachel that he was her father's brother and that he was Rebekah's son. And she ran and reported to her father according to these words.
verses.29:13: And it happened when Laban heard the name of Jacob, his sister's son, he ran to meet him, and embraced him and kissed him, and brought him into his house. And he recounted to Laban all these matters.
verses.29:14: And Laban said to him, "You are of my bones and of my flesh." And he was with him a month of days.
verses.29:15: And Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my brother, you will not serve me for nothing; tell me what your wages are."
verses.29:16: Now Laban had two daughters: the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.29:17: And Leah's eyes were weak, but Rachel was lovely in form and beautiful in appearance.
verses.29:18: Now Jacob loved Rachel, and he said, "I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter."
verses.29:19: And Laban said to him, "It is better for me to give her to you than for me to give her to another man; live with me."
verses.29:20: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel.
verses.29:21: And Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife, for my days have been fulfilled, so that I may go in to her."
verses.29:22: And Laban gathered all the men of the place and held a wedding.
verses.29:23: And evening came, and taking Leah his daughter, he brought her in to Jacob, and Jacob went in to her.
verses.29:24: And Laban gave his maidservant Zilpah to Leah his daughter as a maidservant for her.
verses.29:25: And morning came, and look, it was Leah. And Jacob said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? Did I not serve you for Rachel? And why did you deceive me?"
verses.29:26: And Laban said, "It is not so in our place, to give the younger before the older;
verses.29:27: complete then the seven days of this one, and I will give you this one also in return for the work that you will work with me yet another seven years."
verses.29:28: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled the seven days of this one; and Laban gave Rachel his daughter to him as a wife.
verses.29:29: And Laban gave his maidservant Bilhah to Rachel his daughter as a maidservant for her.
verses.29:30: And he went in to Rachel, and he loved Rachel more than Leah; and he served him another seven years.
verses.29:31: Now when the Lord God saw that Leah was hated, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
verses.29:32: And Leah conceived and bore a son to Jacob, and she called his name Reuben, saying, "Because the Lord has seen my humiliation; now my husband will love me."
verses.29:33: And Leah conceived again and bore a second son to Jacob, and she said, "The Lord has heard that I am hated, and He has given me this one also." And she called his name Simeon.
verses.29:34: And she conceived again and bore a son, and she said, "At the present time my husband will be on my side, for I have borne him three sons." Therefore his name was called Levi.
verses.29:35: And conceiving again, she bore a son, and she said, "Now yet this time I will give thanks to the Lord." Therefore she called his name Judah. And she stopped giving birth.
verses.30:1: Now when Rachel saw that she had not borne children to Jacob, Rachel envied her sister and said to Jacob, "Give me children, or else I will die."
verses.30:2: And Jacob became angry with Rachel and said to her, "Am I in the place of God, who has deprived you of the fruit of the womb?"
verses.30:3: And Rachel said to Jacob, "Here is my female servant Bilhah; go in to her, and she will give birth on my knees, so that I too may have children through her."
verses.30:4: And she gave him her female servant Bilhah as a wife, and Jacob went in to her.
verses.30:5: And Bilhah, Rachel's female servant, conceived and bore a son to Jacob.
verses.30:6: And Rachel said, "God has judged in my favor, and has heard my voice, and has given me a son." Therefore she called his name Dan.
verses.30:7: And Bilhah, Rachel's female servant, conceived again and bore a second son to Jacob.
verses.30:8: And Rachel said, "God has helped me, and I have contended with my sister and prevailed." And she called his name Naphtali.
verses.30:9: Now Leah saw that she had stopped bearing children, and she took her female servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.30:10: And Jacob went in to her, and Zilpah, Leah's female servant, conceived and bore a son to Jacob.
verses.30:11: And Leah said, "With good fortune!" And she named him Gad.
verses.30:12: And Zilpah, Leah's female servant, conceived again and bore yet a second son to Jacob.
verses.30:13: And Leah said, "Blessed am I, for all the women call me blessed." And she called his name Asher.
verses.30:14: Now Reuben went out in the days of the wheat harvest and found mandrake apples in the field, and he brought them to his mother Leah. And Rachel said to Leah, "Give me some of your son's mandrakes."
verses.30:15: And Leah said, "Is it not enough for you that you have taken my husband? Will you also take my son's mandrakes?" And Rachel said, "Not so; let him lie with you tonight in exchange for your son's mandrakes."
verses.30:16: Now Jacob came in from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him and said, "You must come in to me today, for I have hired you in exchange for my son's mandrakes." And he lay with her that night.
verses.30:17: And God heard her, and she conceived and bore a fifth son to Jacob.
verses.30:18: And Leah said, "God has given me my wages because I gave my female servant to my husband." And she called his name Issachar, which means "Wages."
verses.30:19: And Leah conceived again and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
verses.30:20: And Leah said, "God has granted me a good gift; at this present time my husband will choose me, for I have borne him six sons." And she called his name Zebulun.
verses.30:21: And after this she bore a daughter and called her name Dinah. And she stopped bearing children.
verses.30:22: Now God remembered Rachel, and God heard her and opened her womb.
verses.30:23: And she conceived and bore a son to Jacob. And Rachel said, "God has taken away my reproach."
verses.30:24: And she called his name Joseph, saying, "May God add to me another son."
verses.30:25: Now it came about, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, "Send me away so that I may go to my place and to my land.
verses.30:26: Give me the wives and the children for whom I have served you, so that I may depart; for you know the service with which I have served you."
verses.30:27: And Laban said to him, "If I have found favor before you, I would have observed omens; for God has blessed me at your coming in.
verses.30:28: Specify your wages to me, and I will give it to you."
verses.30:29: And Jacob said to him, "You know how I have served you, and how much livestock of yours was with me.
verses.30:30: For what was before me was little, and it increased to a multitude, and the Lord blessed you at my foot. Now then, when will I also make a house for myself?"
verses.30:31: And Laban said to him, "What should I give you?" And Jacob said to him, "You will give me nothing; if you do this thing for me, I will again shepherd your sheep and keep them.
verses.30:32: Let your sheep pass by today, and separate from there every dark-gray sheep among the lambs and every speckled and white one among the goats; it will be my wages.
verses.30:33: And my righteousness will answer for me tomorrow, because my wages are before you: every one that is not speckled and white-streaked among the goats and dark-gray among the lambs will be stolen with me."
verses.30:34: And Laban said to him, "Let it be according to your word."
verses.30:35: And he separated on that day the speckled and white-streaked male goats, and all the speckled and white-streaked female goats, and every one that was white among them, and every one that was dark-gray among the lambs, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.30:36: And he put a three days' journey between them and Jacob, while Jacob shepherded the sheep of Laban that were left behind.
verses.30:37: Now Jacob took for himself a fresh rod of storax, and of walnut, and of plane tree, and Jacob peeled white strips on them, stripping away the green; and on the rods the white that he had peeled appeared variegated.
verses.30:38: And he set the rods that he had peeled in the troughs of the watering places of water, so that whenever the sheep came to drink in front of the rods, and when they came to drink, the sheep would come into heat toward the rods.
verses.30:39: And the sheep bore white-streaked and variegated and ash-colored speckled young.
verses.30:40: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set in front of the sheep a white-streaked ram and every variegated one among the lambs; and he set apart flocks for himself by himself, and did not mix them with Laban's sheep.
verses.30:41: Now it came about at the time when the sheep were in heat, conceiving, that Jacob placed the rods in front of the sheep in the troughs, so that they would come into heat facing the rods;
verses.30:42: for whenever the sheep gave birth, he would not place them; so the unmarked ones became Laban's, and the marked ones became Jacob's.
verses.30:43: And the man became very, very rich, and he came to have much livestock, and cattle, and male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.31:1: Now Jacob heard the words of the sons of Laban, saying, "Jacob has taken everything that belonged to our father, and from what belonged to our father he has made all this glory."
verses.31:2: And Jacob saw the face of Laban, and look, it was not toward him as yesterday and the day before.
verses.31:3: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your father and to your family, and I will be with you."
verses.31:4: So Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field where the flocks were,
verses.31:5: and said to them, "I see the face of your father, that it is not with me as yesterday and the day before; yet the God of my father was with me.
verses.31:6: And you yourselves know that with all my strength I have served your father.
verses.31:7: Yet your father cheated me and changed my wages of the ten lambs, and God did not allow him to harm me.
verses.31:8: If he spoke like this, 'The variegated ones will be your wages,' then all the sheep would bear variegated ones; and if he said, 'The white ones will be your wages,' then all the sheep would bear white ones.
verses.31:9: And God took away all the livestock of your father and gave them to me.
verses.31:10: And it came about at the time when the sheep were conceiving, that I saw with my eyes in my sleep, and look, the male goats and the rams were mounting the sheep and the goats, white-streaked, and variegated, and ash-colored speckled.
verses.31:11: And the angel of God said to me in my sleep, 'Jacob, Jacob.' And I said, 'What is it?'
verses.31:12: And he said, 'Look up with your eyes and see the male goats and the rams mounting the sheep and the goats, white-streaked, and variegated, and ash-colored speckled; for I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.
verses.31:13: I am the God who appeared to you in the place where you anointed a pillar to Me there and vowed a vow to Me there. Now therefore, arise and go out from this land, and go to the land of your birth, and I will be with you.'"
verses.31:14: And Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, "Is there still any portion or inheritance for us in the house of our father?
verses.31:15: Have we not been counted as foreigners by him? For he has sold us and has completely devoured our silver.
verses.31:16: All the wealth and the glory that God has taken away from our father will belong to us and to our children. Now therefore, do whatever God has said to you."
verses.31:17: Then Jacob arose and took his wives and his children onto the camels,
verses.31:18: and led away all his possessions and all his goods that he had acquired in Mesopotamia, and all that was his, to go to Isaac his father to the land of Canaan.
verses.31:19: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel stole the idols of her father.
verses.31:20: And Jacob concealed it from Laban the Syrian, not telling him that he was fleeing.
verses.31:21: So he fled, he and all that was his, and crossed the river, and hurried toward the mountain of Gilead.
verses.31:22: Now it was reported to Laban the Syrian on the third day that Jacob had fled.
verses.31:23: And taking all his brothers with him, he pursued after him a journey of seven days, and overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.31:24: And God came to Laban the Syrian in his sleep during the night and said to him, "Guard yourself so that you never speak evil things with Jacob."
verses.31:25: And Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent on the mountain, and Laban stationed his brothers on the mountain of Gilead.
verses.31:26: Then Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done? Why did you flee secretly and rob me, and carry off my daughters like captives of the sword?
verses.31:27: And if you had told me, I would have sent you away with gladness and with music, tambourines, and lyre.
verses.31:28: I was not counted worthy to kiss my children and my daughters. Now you have acted foolishly.
verses.31:29: And now my hand has strength to harm you; but the God of your father spoke to me yesterday, saying, 'Guard yourself so that you never speak evil things with Jacob.'
verses.31:30: Now then, you have gone away, for you deeply longed to go to the house of your father; yet why did you steal my gods?"
verses.31:31: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, "Because I said, 'Perhaps you might take away your daughters from me and all that is mine.'"
verses.31:32: And Jacob said to him, "The one with whom you find your gods shall not live before our brothers. Identify what of yours is with me, and take it." And he identified nothing with him; now Jacob did not know that Rachel his wife had stolen them.
verses.31:33: So Laban went in and searched the house of Leah, and did not find them; and coming out of the house of Leah, he searched the house of Jacob and the house of the two female servants, and did not find them; and he also went into the house of Rachel.
verses.31:34: Now Rachel had taken the idols and put them into the saddlebags of the camel, and sat on them.
verses.31:35: And she said to her father, "Do not be displeased, lord; I cannot rise before you, because what is according to the custom of women is upon me." So Laban searched throughout the whole house, and did not find the idols.
verses.31:36: Then Jacob became angry and quarreled with Laban; and Jacob answered and said to Laban, "What is my wrongdoing and what is my sin, that you have pursued after me?
verses.31:37: And since you have searched all the articles of my house, what have you found from all the articles of your house? Set it here before your brothers and my brothers, and let them decide between the two of us.
verses.31:38: These twenty years I have been with you; your sheep and your goats have not miscarried, and rams of your sheep I have not eaten.
verses.31:39: What was caught by wild beasts I did not bring to you; I paid it back myself, thefts of the day and thefts of the night.
verses.31:40: By day I was scorched by the heat and by frost at night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.
verses.31:41: These twenty years I have been in your house; I served you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years among your sheep, and you defrauded me of my wages by ten ewe-lambs.
verses.31:42: If the God of my father Abraham and the Fear of Isaac had not been for me, now you would have sent me away empty-handed. God saw my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you yesterday."
verses.31:43: And Laban answered and said to Jacob, "Your daughters are my daughters, and your sons are my sons, and your livestock are my livestock, and everything that you see is mine. Yet what can I do today to these daughters of mine, or to their children whom they have borne?
verses.31:44: Now therefore, come, let us make a covenant, you and I, and it will be for a witness between me and you." And Jacob said to him, "Look, no one is with us; see, God is witness between me and you."
verses.31:45: Then Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
verses.31:46: And Jacob said to his brothers, "Gather stones." So they gathered stones and made a heap, and they ate and drank there on the heap. And Laban said to him, "This heap testifies between me and you today."
verses.31:47: And Laban called it Witness Heap, while Jacob called it Heap Testifies.
verses.31:48: And Laban said to Jacob, "Look, this heap and this pillar that I have set up between me and you; this heap testifies, and this pillar testifies." Therefore its name was called Heap Testifies,
verses.31:49: and The Vision, of which he said, "May God watch between me and you, because we will part one from the other.
verses.31:50: If you afflict my daughters, if you take wives in addition to my daughters, see, no one is with us.
verses.31:52: For if I do not cross over to you, neither may you cross over to me past this heap and this pillar for harm.
verses.31:53: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor will judge between us." And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
verses.31:54: And Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain, and called his brothers, and they ate and drank, and slept on the mountain.
verses.32:1: Now Laban rose in the morning, kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them; and Laban turned back and departed to his place.
verses.32:2: And Jacob went away on his own way; and looking up with his eyes, he saw a camp of God encamped, and the angels of God met him.
verses.32:3: And Jacob said, when he saw them, "This is a camp of God"; and he called the name of that place Camps.
verses.32:4: Now Jacob sent messengers to Esau his brother, into the land of Seir, into the country of Edom,
verses.32:5: and commanded them, saying, "Thus you shall say to my lord Esau: 'Thus says your servant Jacob: I have sojourned with Laban and lingered until now;
verses.32:6: and I have acquired cattle and donkeys and sheep, and male servants and female servants; and I have sent to report to my lord Esau, so that your servant may find favor before you.'"
verses.32:7: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau, and he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."
verses.32:8: Then Jacob was exceedingly afraid and was at a loss; and he divided the people who were with him, and the cattle and the sheep, into two camps.
verses.32:9: And Jacob said, "If Esau comes to one camp and cuts it down, the second camp will be saved."
verses.32:10: Then Jacob said, "God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, Lord, who said to me, 'Hurry back to the land of your birth, and I will treat you well';
verses.32:11: You are sufficient for me from all the righteousness and from all the truth that You have done for Your servant; for with my staff I crossed this Jordan, and now I have become two camps.
verses.32:12: Deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid of him, for fear that he may come and strike me, and mother with children.
verses.32:13: Yet You said, 'I will surely treat you well, and I will make your seed like the sand of the sea, which will not be numbered because of its multitude.'"
verses.32:14: And he slept there that night. And from what he was bringing he took gifts and sent them out to Esau his brother:
verses.32:15: two hundred female goats, twenty male goats, two hundred sheep, twenty rams,
verses.32:16: thirty nursing camels and their young, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty donkeys, ten colts.
verses.32:17: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, each flock by itself. And he said to his servants, "Go on ahead before me, and put a space between flock and flock."
verses.32:18: And he commanded the first, saying, "If my brother Esau meets you and asks you, saying, 'Whose are you? And where are you going? And whose are these going ahead of you?'
verses.32:19: then you shall say, 'Your servant Jacob's; he has sent gifts to my lord Esau, and look, he himself is behind us.'"
verses.32:20: And he commanded the first and the second and the third and all those proceeding behind these flocks, saying, "According to this word speak to Esau when you find him,
verses.32:21: and you shall say, 'Look, your servant Jacob is coming behind us.'" For he said, "I will appease his face with the gifts going ahead of him, and after this I will see his face; for perhaps he will accept my face."
verses.32:22: So the gifts went on ahead before his face; and he himself slept that night in the camp.
verses.32:23: Now rising up that night, he took the two wives and the two female servants and his eleven children, and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.32:24: And he took them and crossed the stream, and he sent across everything that was his.
verses.32:25: And Jacob was left behind alone, and a man wrestled with him until morning.
verses.32:26: And he saw that he could not prevail against him, and he touched the flat of his thigh, and the flat of Jacob's thigh grew numb as he wrestled with him.
verses.32:27: And he said to him, "Let me go, for the dawn has risen." But he said, "I will by no means let you go unless you bless me."
verses.32:28: And he said to him, "What is your name?" And he said, "Jacob."
verses.32:29: And he said to him, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name; for you have prevailed with God, and with men you are powerful."
verses.32:30: Then Jacob asked and said, "Tell me your name." And he said, "Why do you ask my name?" And he blessed him there.
verses.32:31: And Jacob called the name of that place Appearance of God, "For I saw God face to face, and my soul was saved."
verses.32:32: Now the sun rose upon him when he passed by the Appearance of God; and he himself was limping on his thigh.
verses.32:33: For on account of this the sons of Israel will not eat the sinew that grew numb, which is on the flat of Jacob's thigh, until this day, because he touched the flat of Jacob's thigh, at the sinew, and it grew numb.
verses.33:1: Now Jacob looked up and saw, and look, Esau his brother was coming, he and four hundred men with him; and Jacob divided the children among Leah and Rachel and the two female servants.
verses.33:2: And he placed the two female servants and their sons first, and Leah and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.
verses.33:3: And he himself went on ahead of them, and bowed down to the ground seven times until he came near to his brother.
verses.33:4: And Esau ran to meet him, and embracing him, kissed him and fell on his neck; and both of them wept.
verses.33:5: And looking up, he saw the women and the children, and said, "What are these to you?" And he said, "The children with whom God has shown mercy to your servant."
verses.33:6: Then the female servants and their children came near and bowed down;
verses.33:7: and Leah and her children came near and bowed down; and after this Rachel and Joseph came near and bowed down.
verses.33:8: And he said, "What are these to you, all these camps that I have met?" And he said, "So that your servant may find favor in your eyes, lord."
verses.33:9: But Esau said, "I have much, brother; let what is yours be yours."
verses.33:10: Then Jacob said, "If I have found favor before you, accept the gifts from my hands; for this reason I have seen your face as one might see the face of God, and you will be pleased with me.
verses.33:11: Take my blessings which I have brought to you, because God has shown mercy to me and I have everything." And he urged him strongly, and he took them.
verses.33:12: And he said, "Let us set out and go straight ahead."
verses.33:13: But he said to him, "My lord knows that the children are rather tender, and the sheep and the cattle are giving birth in my care; if then I drive them hard for one day, all the livestock will die.
verses.33:14: Let my lord go on ahead before the servant; and I will gain strength along the way at the leisurely pace of the journey before me and at the pace of the young children, until I come to my lord in Seir."
verses.33:15: Then Esau said, "I will leave with you some of the people who are with me." But he said, "Why this? It is enough that I have found favor before you, lord."
verses.33:16: So Esau returned on that day on his way to Seir.
verses.33:17: And Jacob set out for Tents; and he made houses for himself there, and for his livestock he made tents; therefore he called the name of that place Tents.
verses.33:18: And Jacob came to Salem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Mesopotamia of Syria; and he encamped in front of the city.
verses.33:19: And he acquired the portion of the field where he pitched his tent from Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred lambs.
verses.33:20: And he set up an altar there and called upon the God of Israel.
verses.34:1: Now Dinah, the daughter of Leah whom she bore to Jacob, went out to observe the daughters of the native inhabitants.
verses.34:2: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Horite, the ruler of the land, saw her; and taking her, he lay with her and humiliated her.
verses.34:3: And he became attached to the soul of Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the maiden, and he spoke to her according to the mind of the maiden.
verses.34:4: And Shechem spoke to Hamor his father, saying, "Take this girl for me as a wife."
verses.34:5: Now Jacob heard that the son of Hamor had defiled Dinah his daughter, and his sons were with his livestock in the field; so Jacob remained silent until they came.
verses.34:6: Then Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
verses.34:7: Now the sons of Jacob came from the field, and when they heard, the men were deeply stung, and it was exceedingly grievous to them, because Shechem had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with the daughter of Jacob; and it shall not be so.
verses.34:8: And Hamor spoke to them, saying, "Shechem my son has chosen your daughter in his soul; therefore give her to him as a wife.
verses.34:9: Intermarry with us; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for your sons.
verses.34:10: And dwell among us, and look, the land is wide before you; dwell and trade upon it, and acquire property in it."
verses.34:11: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, "May I find favor before you, and whatever you tell us, we will give.
verses.34:12: Increase the bride-price greatly, and I will give according to whatever you tell me, and you will give me this girl as a wife."
verses.34:13: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit and spoke to them, because they had defiled Dinah their sister.
verses.34:14: And Simeon and Levi, the brothers of Dinah and sons of Leah, said to them, "We will not be able to do this, to give our sister to a man who has a foreskin, for it is a reproach to us.
verses.34:15: In this we will become like you and dwell among you, if you also become like us by having every male among you circumcised;
verses.34:16: then we will give our daughters to you, and from your daughters we will take wives for ourselves, and we will dwell with you, and we will be as one people.
verses.34:17: But if you do not listen to us to be circumcised, taking our daughters we will depart."
verses.34:18: And the words were pleasing before Hamor and before Shechem the son of Hamor.
verses.34:19: And the young man did not delay to do this thing, for he was deeply attached to the daughter of Jacob; and he himself was the most honored of all those in the house of his father.
verses.34:20: So Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and they spoke to the men of their city, saying,
verses.34:21: "These men are peaceful with us; let them dwell upon the land and trade in it, and look, the land is wide before them. We will take their daughters for ourselves as wives, and we will give our daughters to them.
verses.34:22: Only in this will the men become like us to dwell with us so as to be one people: by having every male among us circumcised, just as they themselves are circumcised.
verses.34:23: And their livestock and their possessions and their four-footed animals--will they not be ours? Only let us become like them in this, and they will dwell with us."
verses.34:24: And all those who went out of the gate of their city listened to Hamor and Shechem his son, and they were circumcised in the flesh of their foreskin, every male.
verses.34:25: Now it came about on the third day, when they were in pain, that the two sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, the brothers of Dinah, each took his sword and entered the city securely and killed every male;
verses.34:26: both Hamor and Shechem his son they killed by the edge of the sword, and they took Dinah out of the house of Shechem and went out.
verses.34:27: And the sons of Jacob came upon the wounded men and plundered the city in which they had defiled Dinah their sister;
verses.34:28: and they took their sheep and their cattle and their donkeys, both whatever was in the city and whatever was in the field.
verses.34:29: And all their persons and all their dependents and their wives they took captive, and they plundered both whatever was in the city and whatever was in the houses.
verses.34:30: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have made me hateful, so that I am offensive to those who inhabit the land, both among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. And I am very few in number, and having gathered against me, they will strike me down, and I will be wiped out, I and my house."
verses.34:31: And they said, "But should they treat our sister like a prostitute?"
verses.35:1: Now God said to Jacob, "Rise, go up to the place Bethel, and dwell there, and make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you were fleeing from the face of Esau your brother."
verses.35:2: And Jacob said to his house and to all those who were with him, "Remove the foreign gods from your midst, and purify yourselves, and change your garments;
verses.35:3: and rising, let us go up to Bethel, and let us make an altar there to God, who heard me in the day of distress, who was with me and preserved me on the way that I traveled."
verses.35:4: And they gave to Jacob the foreign gods that were in their hands and the earrings that were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the terebinth that was in Shechem and destroyed them until the present day.
verses.35:5: And Israel departed from Shechem, and a fear of God came upon the cities around them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Israel.
verses.35:6: And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people who were with him.
verses.35:7: And he built an altar there and called the name of the place Bethel, for there God had appeared to him when he was fleeing from the face of Esau his brother.
verses.35:8: Now Deborah, the nurse of Rebekah, died below Bethel under the oak, and Jacob called its name Oak of Mourning.
verses.35:9: And God appeared to Jacob again in Luz, when he arrived from Mesopotamia of Syria, and God blessed him.
verses.35:10: And God said to him, "Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel will be your name."
verses.35:11: And God said to him, "I am your God; increase and multiply, and nations and assemblies of nations will come from you, and kings will go forth from your loins.
verses.35:12: And the land that I have given to Abraham and Isaac, to you I have given it, and to your seed after you I will give this land."
verses.35:13: Then God went up from him from the place where He had spoken with him.
verses.35:14: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He had spoken with him, a pillar of stone; and he poured out a drink offering upon it and poured oil upon it.
verses.35:15: And Jacob called the name of the place where God had spoken with him there Bethel.
verses.35:16: Now Jacob, departing from Bethel, pitched his tent beyond the tower of Gader. And it came about when he drew near Chabratha to come into the land of Ephrathah, that Rachel gave birth, and she had a difficult labor in childbirth.
verses.35:17: And it came about while she was giving birth with difficulty that the midwife said to her, "Take courage, for this one too is a son."
verses.35:18: And it came about as she was giving up her soul, for she was dying, that she called his name Son of My Pain; but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.35:19: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrathah, that is, Bethlehem.
verses.35:20: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her tomb; this is the pillar of the tomb of Rachel until the present day.
verses.35:22: And it came about when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, the concubine of his father; and Israel heard, and it appeared evil before him. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.35:23: the sons of Leah: Jacob's firstborn Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun;
verses.35:24: and the sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;
verses.35:25: and the sons of Bilhah, the maidservant of Rachel: Dan and Naphtali;
verses.35:26: and the sons of Zilpah, the maidservant of Leah: Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Mesopotamia of Syria.
verses.35:27: And Jacob came to Isaac his father to Mamre, to the city of the plain, that is, Hebron in the land of Canaan, where Abraham and Isaac had sojourned.
verses.35:28: And the days of Isaac that he lived were one hundred eighty years.
verses.35:29: And expiring, he died and was added to his people, old and full of days; and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.
verses.36:1: Now these are the generations of Esau; he is Edom.
verses.36:2: Now Esau took wives for himself from the daughters of the Canaanites: Adah, daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah, daughter of Anah the son of Zibeon the Hivite,
verses.36:3: and Basemath, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.36:4: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel,
verses.36:5: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.36:6: And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and all the persons of his household, and all the possessions and the livestock, and everything that he had acquired and everything that he had gained in the land of Canaan; and he went out of the land of Canaan away from the presence of Jacob his brother.
verses.36:7: For their possessions were too many for them to dwell together, and the land of their sojourning could not support them because of the abundance of their possessions.
verses.36:8: So Esau dwelt in the hill country of Seir; Esau, he is Edom.
verses.36:9: Now these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom, in the hill country of Seir.
verses.36:10: And these are the names of the sons of Esau: Eliphaz, the son of Adah the wife of Esau, and Reuel, the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.
verses.36:11: Now the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zophar, Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.36:12: Now Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz the son of Esau, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Adah the wife of Esau.
verses.36:13: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah; these were the sons of Basemath the wife of Esau.
verses.36:14: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, daughter of Anah the son of Zibeon, the wife of Esau; and she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.36:15: These are the chiefs of the son of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau: Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zophar, Chief Kenaz,
verses.36:16: Chief Korah, Chief Gatam, Chief Amalek; these are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Idumea; these are the sons of Adah.
verses.36:17: And these are the sons of Reuel, the son of Esau: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Mizzah, Chief Shammah; these are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
verses.36:18: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, the wife of Esau: Chief Jeush, Chief Jalam, Chief Korah; these are the chiefs of Oholibamah.
verses.36:19: And these are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs; these are their chiefs, the sons of Edom.
verses.36:20: Now these are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.36:21: and Dishon, Saar, and Rison; these are the chiefs of the Horite, the son of Seir, in the land of Edom.
verses.36:22: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Heman; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
verses.36:23: And these are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Oman.
verses.36:24: And these are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Onan; this is the Onas who found Jamin in the wilderness when he was pasturing the beasts of burden of Zibeon his father.
verses.36:25: And these are the sons of Anah: Dishon, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.36:26: And these are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.36:27: And these are the sons of Saar: Bilhan, Zukam, Jukam, and Ukan.
verses.36:28: And these are the sons of Rison: Uz and Aram.
verses.36:29: These are the chiefs of Hori: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,
verses.36:30: Chief Dishon, Chief Saar, Chief Rison; these are the chiefs of Hori in their chiefdoms in the land of Edom.
verses.36:31: And these are the kings who reigned in Edom before a king reigned in Jerusalem.
verses.36:32: And Balak the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.36:33: Then Balak died, and Jobab the son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.36:34: Then Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.36:35: Then Husham died, and Hadad the son of Barad, who struck down Midian in the plain of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Gethaim.
verses.36:36: Then Hadad died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.36:37: Then Samlah died, and Shaul from Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place.
verses.36:38: Then Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.36:39: Then Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Arath the son of Barath reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Peor, and the name of his wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the son of Me-zahab.
verses.36:40: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau in their tribes, according to their place, in their regions and in their nations: Chief Timna, Chief Alvah, Chief Jeber,
verses.36:41: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Phines,
verses.36:42: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,
verses.36:43: Chief Metodiel, Chief Zaphoi; these are the chiefs of Edom in the built-up places in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of Edom.
verses.37:1: Now Jacob lived in the land where his father had sojourned, in the land of Canaan. And these are the generations of Jacob.
verses.37:2: Joseph, seventeen years old, was shepherding the sheep with his brothers, being young, with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives; and they brought an evil accusation against Joseph to Israel their father.
verses.37:3: Now Jacob loved Joseph more than all his sons, because he was a son of his old age; and he made him a multicolored tunic.
verses.37:4: And when his brothers saw that his father loved him more than all his sons, they hated him and could not speak anything peaceful to him.
verses.37:5: Then Joseph dreamed a dream and reported it to his brothers,
verses.37:6: and he said to them, "Listen to this dream that I have dreamed:
verses.37:7: I thought you were binding sheaves in the middle of the field, and my sheaf rose up and stood upright; and your sheaves turned around and bowed down to my sheaf."
verses.37:8: And his brothers said to him, "Will you really reign over us, or will you really rule over us?" So they hated him even more because of his dreams and because of his words.
verses.37:9: Then he saw another dream, and he recounted it to his father and to his brothers, and said, "Look, I have dreamed another dream: it was as if the sun and the moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me."
verses.37:10: And his father rebuked him and said, "What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers really come to bow down to you to the ground?"
verses.37:11: And his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the saying in mind.
verses.37:12: Now his brothers went to Shechem to pasture their father's sheep.
verses.37:13: And Israel said to Joseph, "Are not your brothers shepherding in Shechem? Come, let me send you to them." And he said to him, "Here I am."
verses.37:14: Then Israel said to him, "Go and see whether your brothers and the sheep are well, and bring word back to me." So he sent him from the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.37:15: And a man found him wandering in the field; and the man asked him, saying, "What are you looking for?"
verses.37:16: And he said, "I am looking for my brothers; tell me where they are pasturing."
verses.37:17: And the man said to him, "They have departed from here, for I heard them saying, 'Let us go to Dothan.'" So Joseph went after his brothers and found them in Dothan.
verses.37:18: And they saw him from a distance before he came near to them, and they were setting out to kill him.
verses.37:19: And each said to his brother, "Look, that dreamer is coming;
verses.37:20: now then, come, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits, and we will say, 'A vicious wild beast has devoured him'; and we will see what his dreams are."
verses.37:21: But when Reuben heard it, he rescued him from their hands and said, "We will not strike him to take his life."
verses.37:22: And Reuben said to them, "Do not shed blood; rather, throw him into one of the pits that are in the wilderness, and do not lay a hand on him"—so that he might rescue him from their hands and return him to his father.
verses.37:23: And it came about, when Joseph came to his brothers, that they stripped Joseph of the multicolored tunic that was on him,
verses.37:24: and taking him, they threw him into the pit; and that pit had no water.
verses.37:25: Then they sat down to eat bread; and lifting up their eyes they looked, and look, Ishmaelite travelers were coming from Gilead, and their camels were loaded with incense and resin and myrrh oil; and they were on their way to bring them down to Egypt.
verses.37:26: And Judah said to his brothers, "What advantage is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.37:27: Come, let us sell him to these Ishmaelites, and let our hands not be on him, for he is our brother and our flesh." And his brothers listened.
verses.37:28: And the men, the Midianite merchants, were passing by, and they pulled Joseph out and brought him up from the pit; and they sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty gold pieces; and they brought Joseph down to Egypt.
verses.37:29: Then Reuben returned to the pit, and he did not see Joseph in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
verses.37:30: And he returned to his brothers and said, "The boy is not there; and as for me, where do I go now?"
